- Make the change without asking clarifying questions; use reasonable assumptions.

### Completed

### Active

- `src/styles.css`: Main game UI styles.
- `src/app.js`: Screen rendering and UI.

125:     pts.push(pts[0].clone())
126:     this.curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts, true, 'catmullrom', 0.5)
127:     this.samples = []
128:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i++) {
129:       const t = i / N_SAMPLES
130:       const p = this.curve.getPointAt(t)
131:       const tan = this.curve.getTangentAt(t)
132:       tan.y = 0
133:       tan.normalize()
134:       const right = new THREE.Vector3(-tan.z, 0, tan.x)
135:       this.samples.push({ p, tan, right })
136:     }
137:     // smooth surface height to avoid nausea
138:     const raw = this.samples.map(s => s.p.y)
139:     for (let iter = 0; iter < 3; iter++) {
140:       for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i++) {
141:         const a = raw[(i - 1 + N_SAMPLES) % N_SAMPLES], b = raw[i], c = raw[(i + 1) % N_SAMPLES]
142:         raw[i] = (a + b * 2 + c) / 4
143:       }
144:     }
145:     this.computeLength()
146:     this.samples.forEach((s, i) => { s.p.y = raw[i] })
147:   }

149:   computeLength() {
150:     let len = 0
151:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i++) {
152:       const a = this.samples[i].p, b = this.samples[(i + 1) % N_SAMPLES].p
153:       len += a.distanceTo(b)
154:     }
155:     this.length = len
156:   }

207:   buildRoad() {
208:     const { samples, width } = this
209:     const roadW = width
210:     const landW = 66
211:     const positions = [], uvs = [], indices = []
212:     const landPos = [], landIdx = []
213:     for (let i = 0; i <= N_SAMPLES; i++) {
214:       const s = samples[i % N_SAMPLES]
215:       const y = s.p.y
216:       const lx = s.p.x - s.right.x * roadW / 2, lz = s.p.z - s.right.z * roadW / 2
217:       const rx = s.p.x + s.right.x * roadW / 2, rz = s.p.z + s.right.z * roadW / 2
218:       positions.push(lx, y + 0.06, lz, rx, y + 0.06, rz)
219:       const v = i * (this.length / N_SAMPLES) / 7
220:       uvs.push(0, v, 1, v)
221:       // land: outer low, inner high
222:       landPos.push(
223:         s.p.x - s.right.x * landW, y - 0.6, s.p.z - s.right.z * landW,
224:         s.p.x - s.right.x * (roadW / 2 + 0.7), y - 0.02, s.p.z - s.right.z * (roadW / 2 + 0.7),
225:         s.p.x + s.right.x * (roadW / 2 + 0.7), y - 0.02, s.p.z + s.right.z * (roadW / 2 + 0.7),
226:         s.p.x + s.right.x * landW, y - 0.6, s.p.z + s.right.z * landW
227:       )
228:     }
229:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i++) {
230:       const a = i * 2, b = a + 1, c = a + 2, d = a + 3
231:       indices.push(a, b, c, b, d, c)
232:       const l = i * 4
233:       // left slope
234:       landIdx.push(l, l + 1, l + 4, l + 1, l + 5, l + 4)
235:       // center
236:       landIdx.push(l + 1, l + 2, l + 5, l + 2, l + 6, l + 5)
237:       // right slope
238:       landIdx.push(l + 2, l + 3, l + 6, l + 3, l + 7, l + 6)
239:     }
240:     const roadGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
241:     roadGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3))
242:     roadGeo.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2))
243:     roadGeo.setIndex(indices)
244:     roadGeo.computeVertexNormals()
245:     const roadMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: makeRoadTexture(this.terrain), color: '#ffffff' })
246:     const road = new THREE.Mesh(roadGeo, roadMat)
247:     this.group.add(road)
248:     this.road = road
249:     this.addDisposable(road)
250: 
251:     const landGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
252:     landGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(landPos, 3))
253:     landGeo.setIndex(landIdx)
254:     landGeo.computeVertexNormals()
255:     const landMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(this.terrain.ground), flatShading: true })
256:     const land = new THREE.Mesh(landGeo, landMat)
257:     this.group.add(land)
258:     this.land = land
259:     this.addDisposable(land)
260: 
261:     // edge markers / barrier posts (instanced)
262:     const postGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.18, 0.9, 0.18)
263:     const postMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(this.terrain.accent).multiplyScalar(0.55) })
264:     const posts = new THREE.InstancedMesh(postGeo, postMat, Math.floor(N_SAMPLES / 10) * 2)
265:     const dummy = new THREE.Object3D()
266:     let pi = 0
267:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i += 10) {
268:       const s = samples[i]
269:       for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
270:         dummy.position.set(s.p.x + s.right.x * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.2), s.p.y + 0.45, s.p.z + s.right.z * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.2))
271:         dummy.rotation.y = Math.atan2(s.tan.x, s.tan.z)
272:         dummy.updateMatrix()
273:         posts.setMatrixAt(pi++, dummy.matrix)
274:       }
275:     }
276:     posts.count = pi
277:     this.group.add(posts)
278:     this.addDisposable(posts)
279: 
280:     // glowing reflectors
281:     const refGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.16, 6, 5)
282:     const refMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: this.terrain.accent })
283:     const refs = new THREE.InstancedMesh(refGeo, refMat, 80)
284:     let ri = 0
285:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i += 20) {
286:       const s = samples[i]
287:       for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
288:         dummy.position.set(s.p.x + s.right.x * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.25), s.p.y + 1.02, s.p.z + s.right.z * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.25))
289:         dummy.rotation.set(0, 0, 0)
290:         dummy.updateMatrix()
291:         refs.setMatrixAt(ri++, dummy.matrix)
292:       }
293:     }
294:     refs.count = ri
295:     this.group.add(refs)
296:     this.addDisposable(refs)
297:   }

299:   buildGate() {

321:     for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) { cx.fillStyle = (i + j) % 2 ? '#e7ddc3' : '#171313'; cx.fillRect(i * 16, j * 16, 16, 16) }
322:     const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c); tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace
323:     const line = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(this.width, 3.2), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: tex }))

347:   propPositions(count, min = 18, max = 55) {
348:     const out = []
349:     const r = this.rand
350:     for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
351:       const i = Math.floor(r() * N_SAMPLES)
352:       const s = this.samples[i]
353:       const side = r() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1
354:       const lateral = min + r() * (max - min)
355:       const baseY = lateral < 36 ? s.p.y - 0.15 : -0.5
356:       out.push({
357:         x: s.p.x + s.right.x * side * lateral,
358:         y: baseY,
359:         z: s.p.z + s.right.z * side * lateral,
360:         rot: r() * Math.PI * 2,
361:         scale: 0.7 + r() * 1.2,
362:         tangent: s.tan,
363:         side
364:       })
365:     }
366:     return out
367:   }

369:   buildInstanced(geo, material, points, mapFn) {
370:     if (!points.length) return null
371:     const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, material, points.length)
372:     const dummy = new THREE.Object3D()
373:     points.forEach((p, i) => {
374:       mapFn(dummy, p, i)
375:       dummy.updateMatrix()
376:       mesh.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix)
377:     })
378:     this.group.add(mesh)
379:     this.addDisposable(mesh)
380:     return mesh
381:   }

- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.

347:   propPositions(count, min = 18, max = 55) {
348:     const out = []
349:     const r = this.rand
350:     for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
351:       const i = Math.floor(r() * N_SAMPLES)
352:       const s = this.samples[i]
353:       const side = r() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1
354:       const lateral = min + r() * (max - min)
355:       const baseY = lateral < 36 ? s.p.y - 0.15 : -0.5
356:       out.push({
357:         x: s.p.x + s.right.x * side * lateral,
358:         y: baseY,
359:         z: s.p.z + s.right.z * side * lateral,
360:         rot: r() * Math.PI * 2,
361:         scale: 0.7 + r() * 1.2,
362:         tangent: s.tan,
363:         side
364:       })
365:     }
366:     return out
367:   }

369:   buildInstanced(geo, material, points, mapFn) {
370:     if (!points.length) return null
371:     const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, material, points.length)
372:     const dummy = new THREE.Object3D()
373:     points.forEach((p, i) => {
374:       mapFn(dummy, p, i)
375:       dummy.updateMatrix()
376:       mesh.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix)
377:     })
378:     this.group.add(mesh)
379:     this.addDisposable(mesh)
380:     return mesh
381:   }

523:   buildWeather() {

527:     this.tornado = null
528:     this.water = null
529:     this.quicksand = null
530:     this.flash = 0
531:     this.nextStrike = 6
532: 
533:     if (w === 'acid' || w === 'storm' || w === 'hurricane') {
534:       const count = this.quality === 'low' ? 600 : 1300
535:       const arr = new Float32Array(count * 3)
536:       for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
537:         arr[i * 3] = (r() - 0.5) * 100
538:         arr[i * 3 + 1] = r() * 45
539:         arr[i * 3 + 2] = (r() - 0.5) * 100
540:       }
541:       const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(arr, 3))
542:       const col = w === 'acid' ? '#8fdc5a' : w === 'storm' ? '#a8bfd8' : '#93b9c2'
543:       this.rain = new THREE.Points(geo, new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color: col, size: 0.12, transparent: true, opacity: 0.55, depthWrite: false }))
544:       this.rain.frustumCulled = false
545:       this.group.add(this.rain)
546:       this.addDisposable(this.rain)
547:       this.rainCount = count
548:     }
549: 
550:     if (w === 'twister') {
551:       this.tornado = this.makeTornado()
552:       this.group.add(this.tornado)
553:     }
554: 
555:     if (w === 'flood') {
556:       const waterMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#2d4540', transparent: true, opacity: 0.5, depthWrite: false })
557:       const water = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(420, 420), waterMat)

560:       this.group.add(water)

565:     if (w === 'quicksand') {
566:       const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = c.height = 128
567:       const x = c.getContext('2d')
568:       x.fillStyle = '#5a4325'; x.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128)
569:       for (let i = 0; i < 48; i++) {
570:         x.fillStyle = `rgba(${90 + r() * 60},${65 + r() * 40},${25 + r() * 30},0.5)`
571:         x.beginPath(); x.arc(r() * 128, r() * 128, 3 + r() * 14, 0, 7); x.fill()
572:       }
573:       const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c)
574:       const mat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: tex, color: '#c0a06a' })
575:       const q = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(420, 420), mat)
576:       q.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; q.position.y = -0.55
577:       this.group.add(q); this.quicksand = q
578:       this.addDisposable(q)
579:     }
580: 
581:     if (w === 'clear' || w === 'cloudy') {
582:       // ash motes / heat shimmer
583:       const count = 160
584:       const arr = new Float32Array(count * 3)
585:       for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) { arr[i * 3] = (r() - 0.5) * 90; arr[i * 3 + 1] = r() * 20; arr[i * 3 + 2] = (r() - 0.5) * 90 }
586:       const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(arr, 3))
587:       this.ash = new THREE.Points(geo, new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color: w === 'clear' ? '#e6b27c' : '#9c948c', size: 0.1, transparent: true, opacity: 0.4, depthWrite: false }))
588:       this.group.add(this.ash); this.addDisposable(this.ash)

595:     this.boltMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0xe6f0ff, transparent: true, opacity: 0 })

606:   makeTornado() {

## Objective
- Adapt HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE’s graphics style toward Slipface’s off-road racing aesthetic while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.
- Save check screenshots as small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Infer Slipface’s style as rugged off-road racing with deformable terrain; no reference screenshots or assets were found in the repository.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected `src/styles.css`, `src/track.js`, `src/car.js`, `src/menu-bg.js`, and `package.json`.

### Active
- Assess the existing visuals and choose an off-road racing direction.
- Implement visual changes and verify with a build and screenshot.

### Blocked
- No external Slipface references are available; the style must be inferred.

## Next Move
1. Inspect remaining relevant assets and screens, especially the car, terrain, and menu presentation.
2. Apply an off-road racing visual direction while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.
3. Build, capture a JPEG within the specified viewport limit, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `src/styles.css`: Main UI styling.
- `src/app.js`: Screen rendering and UI.
- `src/menu-bg.js`: Procedural menu backdrop.
- `src/track.js`: Track and terrain visuals.
- `src/car.js`: Vehicle visuals.
- `src/race.js`: Gameplay rendering.
- `package.json`: Build scripts.

## Important Context
- HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE is an apocalyptic racing RPG.
- No changes or screenshots have been made yet.

347:   propPositions(count, min = 18, max = 55) {
348:     const out = []
349:     const r = this.rand
350:     for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
351:       const i = Math.floor(r() * N_SAMPLES)
352:       const s = this.samples[i]
353:       const side = r() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1
354:       const lateral = min + r() * (max - min)
355:       const baseY = lateral < 36 ? s.p.y - 0.15 : -0.5
356:       out.push({
357:         x: s.p.x + s.right.x * side * lateral,
358:         y: baseY,
359:         z: s.p.z + s.right.z * side * lateral,
360:         rot: r() * Math.PI * 2,
361:         scale: 0.7 + r() * 1.2,
362:         tangent: s.tan,
363:         side
364:       })
365:     }
366:     return out
367:   }

369:   buildInstanced(geo, material, points, mapFn) {
370:     if (!points.length) return null
371:     const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, material, points.length)
372:     const dummy = new THREE.Object3D()
373:     points.forEach((p, i) => {
374:       mapFn(dummy, p, i)
375:       dummy.updateMatrix()
376:       mesh.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix)
377:     })
378:     this.group.add(mesh)
379:     this.addDisposable(mesh)
380:     return mesh
381:   }

606:   makeTornado() {
607:     const g = new THREE.Group()
608:     const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#8c7b65', transparent: true, opacity: 0.2, side: THREE.DoubleSide, depthWrite: false })
609:     const rings = []
610:     for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
611:       const ring = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.2 + i * 1.4, 2.4 + i * 2.3, 7, 16, 1, true), mat)
612:       ring.position.y = 3 + i * 5
613:       ring.userData.spin = 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.8
614:       g.add(ring); rings.push(ring)
615:     }
616:     const s = this.samples[Math.floor(this.samples.length * 0.68)]
617:     const side = this.rand() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1
618:     g.position.set(s.p.x + s.right.x * side * 38, s.p.y - 1, s.p.z + s.right.z * side * 38)
619:     g.userData.rings = rings
620:     g.userData.radius = 20
621:     return g
622:   }

624:   nearest(pos, hint = 0, window = 46) {
625:     let best = -1, bestD = Infinity
626:     const start = hint - window, end = hint + window
627:     for (let k = start; k <= end; k++) {
628:       const i = ((k % N_SAMPLES) + N_SAMPLES) % N_SAMPLES
629:       const s = this.samples[i]
630:       const dx = pos.x - s.p.x, dz = pos.z - s.p.z
631:       const d = dx * dx + dz * dz
632:       if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = i }
633:     }
634:     if (bestD > 900) {
635:       for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i += 8) {
636:         const s = this.samples[i]
637:         const dx = pos.x - s.p.x, dz = pos.z - s.p.z
638:         const d = dx * dx + dz * dz
639:         if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = i }
640:       }
641:     }
642:     const s = this.samples[best]
643:     const dx = pos.x - s.p.x, dz = pos.z - s.p.z
644:     const lateral = dx * s.right.x + dz * s.right.z
645:     return { index: best, distance: Math.sqrt(bestD), lateral, sample: s }
646:   }

648:   sampleAt(index) {
649:     return this.samples[((index % N_SAMPLES) + N_SAMPLES) % N_SAMPLES]
650:   }

652:   worldAt(index, lateral = 0, yOff = 0) {
653:     const s = this.sampleAt(index)
654:     return new THREE.Vector3(s.p.x + s.right.x * lateral, s.p.y + yOff, s.p.z + s.right.z * lateral)
655:   }

657:   startPose(slot = 0) {
658:     // grid behind the start line, staggered rows
659:     const row = Math.floor(slot / 2)
660:     const col = slot % 2

## Objective
- Adapt HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE’s graphics toward Slipface’s off-road racing aesthetic while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.
- Save check screenshots as small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Infer Slipface’s style as rugged off-road racing with deformable terrain; no reference screenshots or assets were found in the repository.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected `package.json`, `src/styles.css`, `src/menu-bg.js`, `src/track.js`, and `src/car.js`.

### Active
- Assess the existing visuals and choose an off-road racing direction.
- Implement visual changes and verify with a build and screenshot.

### Blocked
- No external Slipface references are available; the style must be inferred.

1. Inspect remaining relevant assets and screens, especially the car, terrain, and menu presentation.
2. Apply an off-road racing visual direction while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.

- `src/race.js`: Gameplay rendering.

- HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE is an apocalyptic racing RPG.

347:   propPositions(count, min = 18, max = 55) {
348:     const out = []
349:     const r = this.rand
350:     for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
351:       const i = Math.floor(r() * N_SAMPLES)
352:       const s = this.samples[i]
353:       const side = r() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1
354:       const lateral = min + r() * (max - min)
355:       const baseY = lateral < 36 ? s.p.y - 0.15 : -0.5
356:       out.push({
357:         x: s.p.x + s.right.x * side * lateral,
358:         y: baseY,
359:         z: s.p.z + s.right.z * side * lateral,
360:         rot: r() * Math.PI * 2,
361:         scale: 0.7 + r() * 1.2,
362:         tangent: s.tan,
363:         side
364:       })
365:     }
366:     return out
367:   }

369:   buildInstanced(geo, material, points, mapFn) {
370:     if (!points.length) return null
371:     const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, material, points.length)
372:     const dummy = new THREE.Object3D()
373:     points.forEach((p, i) => {
374:       mapFn(dummy, p, i)
375:       dummy.updateMatrix()
376:       mesh.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix)
377:     })
378:     this.group.add(mesh)
379:     this.addDisposable(mesh)
380:     return mesh
381:   }

523:   buildWeather() {
524:     const w = this.weather.id
525:     const r = this.rand
526:     this.precip = null
527:     this.tornado = null
528:     this.water = null
529:     this.quicksand = null
530:     this.flash = 0
531:     this.nextStrike = 6
532: 
533:     if (w === 'acid' || w === 'storm' || w === 'hurricane') {
534:       const count = this.quality === 'low' ? 600 : 1300
535:       const arr = new Float32Array(count * 3)
536:       for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
537:         arr[i * 3] = (r() - 0.5) * 100
538:         arr[i * 3 + 1] = r() * 45
539:         arr[i * 3 + 2] = (r() - 0.5) * 100
540:       }
541:       const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(arr, 3))
542:       const col = w === 'acid' ? '#8fdc5a' : w === 'storm' ? '#a8bfd8' : '#93b9c2'
543:       this.rain = new THREE.Points(geo, new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color: col, size: 0.12, transparent: true, opacity: 0.55, depthWrite: false }))
544:       this.rain.frustumCulled = false
545:       this.group.add(this.rain)
546:       this.addDisposable(this.rain)
547:       this.rainCount = count
548:     }
549: 
550:     if (w === 'twister') {
551:       this.tornado = this.makeTornado()
552:       this.group.add(this.tornado)
553:     }
554: 
555:     if (w === 'flood') {
556:       const waterMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#2d4540', transparent: true, opacity: 0.5, depthWrite: false })
557:       const water = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(420, 420), waterMat)
558:       water.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2
559:       water.position.y = -0.18
560:       this.group.add(water)
561:       this.water = water
562:       this.addDisposable(water)

564: 
565:     if (w === 'quicksand') {
566:       const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = c.height = 128
567:       const x = c.getContext('2d')
568:       x.fillStyle = '#5a4325'; x.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128)
569:       for (let i = 0; i < 48; i++) {

571:         x.beginPath(); x.arc(r() * 128, r() * 128, 3 + r() * 14, 0, 7); x.fill()
572:       }
573:       const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c)
574:       const mat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: tex, color: '#c0a06a' })
575:       const q = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(420, 420), mat)
576:       q.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; q.position.y = -0.55
577:       this.group.add(q); this.quicksand = q
578:       this.addDisposable(q)
579:     }
580: 
581:     if (w === 'clear' || w === 'cloudy') {
582:       // ash motes / heat shimmer
583:       const count = 160
584:       const arr = new Float32Array(count * 3)
585:       for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) { arr[i * 3] = (r() - 0.5) * 90; arr[i * 3 + 1] = r() * 20; arr[i * 3 + 2] = (r() - 0.5) * 90 }
586:       const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(arr, 3))
587:       this.ash = new THREE.Points(geo, new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color: w === 'clear' ? '#e6b27c' : '#9c948c', size: 0.1, transparent: true, opacity: 0.4, depthWrite: false }))
588:       this.group.add(this.ash); this.addDisposable(this.ash)
589:     }

595:     this.boltMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0xe6f0ff, transparent: true, opacity: 0 })

606:   makeTornado() {
607:     const g = new THREE.Group()
608:     const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#8c7b65', transparent: true, opacity: 0.2, side: THREE.DoubleSide, depthWrite: false })
609:     const rings = []
610:     for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
611:       const ring = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.2 + i * 1.4, 2.4 + i * 2.3, 7, 16, 1, true), mat)
612:       ring.position.y = 3 + i * 5
613:       ring.userData.spin = 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.8
614:       g.add(ring); rings.push(ring)
615:     }
616:     const s = this.samples[Math.floor(this.samples.length * 0.68)]
617:     const side = this.rand() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1
618:     g.position.set(s.p.x + s.right.x * side * 38, s.p.y - 1, s.p.z + s.right.z * side * 38)
619:     g.userData.rings = rings
620:     g.userData.radius = 20
621:     return g
622:   }

624:   nearest(pos, hint = 0, window = 46) {
625:     let best = -1, bestD = Infinity
626:     const start = hint - window, end = hint + window
627:     for (let k = start; k <= end; k++) {
628:       const i = ((k % N_SAMPLES) + N_SAMPLES) % N_SAMPLES
629:       const s = this.samples[i]
630:       const dx = pos.x - s.p.x, dz = pos.z - s.p.z
631:       const d = dx * dx + dz * dz
632:       if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = i }
633:     }
634:     if (bestD > 900) {
635:       for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i += 8) {
636:         const s = this.samples[i]
637:         const dx = pos.x - s.p.x, dz = pos.z - s.p.z
638:         const d = dx * dx + dz * dz
639:         if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = i }
640:       }
641:     }
642:     const s = this.samples[best]
643:     const dx = pos.x - s.p.x, dz = pos.z - s.p.z
644:     const lateral = dx * s.right.x + dz * s.right.z
645:     return { index: best, distance: Math.sqrt(bestD), lateral, sample: s }
646:   }

648:   sampleAt(index) {
649:     return this.samples[((index % N_SAMPLES) + N_SAMPLES) % N_SAMPLES]
650:   }
651: 
652:   worldAt(index, lateral = 0, yOff = 0) {
653:     const s = this.sampleAt(index)
654:     return new THREE.Vector3(s.p.x + s.right.x * lateral, s.p.y + yOff, s.p.z + s.right.z * lateral)
655:   }

657:   startPose(slot = 0) {
658:     // grid behind the start line, staggered rows
659:     const row = Math.floor(slot / 2)
660:     const col = slot % 2
661:     const index = 18 + row * 13
662:     const s = this.sampleAt(index)
663:     const lateral = (col === 0 ? -1 : 1) * 3.6
664:     return {
665:       pos: new THREE.Vector3(s.p.x + s.right.x * lateral, s.p.y + 0.02, s.p.z + s.right.z * lateral),
666:       yaw: Math.atan2(s.tan.x, s.tan.z),
667:       index,
668:       lateral
669:     }
670:   }

679:   update(dt, cameraPos = null) {
680:     this.t += dt
681:     const w = this.weather.id
682:     if (this.rain) {
683:       const p = this.rain.geometry.attributes.position.array
684:       const wind = this.weather.wind
685:       const speed = w === 'hurricane' ? 36 : 22
686:       for (let i = 0; i < this.rainCount; i++) {
687:         p[i * 3 + 1] -= speed * dt
688:         p[i * 3] += (2.2 + wind * 5) * dt
689:         p[i * 3 + 2] += wind * 1.4 * dt
690:         if (p[i * 3 + 1] < -2) {
691:           p[i * 3 + 1] = 40
692:           p[i * 3] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 110
693:           p[i * 3 + 2] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 110

## Objective
- Adapt HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE’s graphics toward Slipface’s off-road racing aesthetic while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.
- Save check screenshots as small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Infer Slipface’s style as rugged off-road racing with deformable terrain; no reference screenshots or assets were found in the repository.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected `src/styles.css`, `src/app.js`, `src/menu-bg.js`, `src/track.js`, `src/car.js`, `src/race.js`, and `package.json`; reviewed the repository file listing.

### Active
- Assess the existing visuals and choose an off-road racing direction.
- Implement visual changes and verify with a build and screenshot.

### Blocked
- No external Slipface references are available; the style must be inferred.

## Next Move
1. Inspect remaining relevant assets and screens, especially the car, terrain, and menu presentation.
2. Apply an off-road racing visual direction while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.
3. Build, capture a JPEG within the specified viewport limit, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `src/styles.css`: Main UI styling.
- `src/app.js`: Screen rendering and UI.
- `src/menu-bg.js`: Procedural menu backdrop.
- `src/track.js`: Track and terrain visuals.
- `src/car.js`: Vehicle visuals.
- `src/race.js`: Gameplay rendering.
- `package.json`: Build scripts.

## Important Context
- HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE is an apocalyptic racing RPG.
- No changes or screenshots have been made yet.

230:       const a = i * 2, b = a + 1, c = a + 2, d = a + 3
231:       indices.push(a, b, c, b, d, c)
232:       const l = i * 4
233:       // left slope
234:       landIdx.push(l, l + 1, l + 4, l + 1, l + 5, l + 4)
235:       // center
236:       landIdx.push(l + 1, l + 2, l + 5, l + 2, l + 6, l + 5)
237:       // right slope
238:       landIdx.push(l + 2, l + 3, l + 6, l + 3, l + 7, l + 6)
239:     }
240:     const roadGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
241:     roadGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3))
242:     roadGeo.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2))
243:     roadGeo.setIndex(indices)
244:     roadGeo.computeVertexNormals()
245:     const roadMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: makeRoadTexture(this.terrain), color: '#ffffff' })
246:     const road = new THREE.Mesh(roadGeo, roadMat)

251:     const landGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
252:     landGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(landPos, 3))
253:     landGeo.setIndex(landIdx)

256:     const land = new THREE.Mesh(landGeo, landMat)

261:     // edge markers / barrier posts (instanced)
262:     const postGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.18, 0.9, 0.18)
263:     const postMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(this.terrain.accent).multiplyScalar(0.55) })
264:     const posts = new THREE.InstancedMesh(postGeo, postMat, Math.floor(N_SAMPLES / 10) * 2)
265:     const dummy = new THREE.Object3D()
266:     let pi = 0
267:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i += 10) {
268:       const s = samples[i]
269:       for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
270:         dummy.position.set(s.p.x + s.right.x * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.2), s.p.y + 0.45, s.p.z + s.right.z * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.2))
271:         dummy.rotation.y = Math.atan2(s.tan.x, s.tan.z)
272:         dummy.updateMatrix()
273:         posts.setMatrixAt(pi++, dummy.matrix)
274:       }
275:     }

278:     this.addDisposable(posts)

283:     const refs = new THREE.InstancedMesh(refGeo, refMat, 80)

289:         dummy.rotation.set(0, 0, 0)

347:   propPositions(count, min = 18, max = 55) {
348:     const out = []
349:     const r = this.rand
350:     for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
351:       const i = Math.floor(r() * N_SAMPLES)
352:       const s = this.samples[i]
353:       const side = r() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1
354:       const lateral = min + r() * (max - min)
355:       const baseY = lateral < 36 ? s.p.y - 0.15 : -0.5
356:       out.push({
357:         x: s.p.x + s.right.x * side * lateral,
358:         y: baseY,
359:         z: s.p.z + s.right.z * side * lateral,
360:         rot: r() * Math.PI * 2,
361:         scale: 0.7 + r() * 1.2,
362:         tangent: s.tan,
363:         side
364:       })
365:     }
366:     return out
367:   }

369:   buildInstanced(geo, material, points, mapFn) {
370:     if (!points.length) return null
371:     const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, material, points.length)
372:     const dummy = new THREE.Object3D()
373:     points.forEach((p, i) => {
374:       mapFn(dummy, p, i)
375:       dummy.updateMatrix()
376:       mesh.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix)
377:     })
378:     this.group.add(mesh)
379:     this.addDisposable(mesh)
380:     return mesh
381:   }

523:   buildWeather() {
524:     const w = this.weather.id
525:     const r = this.rand
526:     this.precip = null
527:     this.tornado = null
528:     this.water = null
529:     this.quicksand = null
530:     this.flash = 0
531:     this.nextStrike = 6
532: 
533:     if (w === 'acid' || w === 'storm' || w === 'hurricane') {
534:       const count = this.quality === 'low' ? 600 : 1300
535:       const arr = new Float32Array(count * 3)
536:       for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
537:         arr[i * 3] = (r() - 0.5) * 100
538:         arr[i * 3 + 1] = r() * 45
539:         arr[i * 3 + 2] = (r() - 0.5) * 100
540:       }
541:       const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(arr, 3))
542:       const col = w === 'acid' ? '#8fdc5a' : w === 'storm' ? '#a8bfd8' : '#93b9c2'
543:       this.rain = new THREE.Points(geo, new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color: col, size: 0.12, transparent: true, opacity: 0.55, depthWrite: false }))
544:       this.rain.frustumCulled = false
545:       this.group.add(this.rain)
546:       this.addDisposable(this.rain)
547:       this.rainCount = count
548:     }
549: 
550:     if (w === 'twister') {
551:       this.tornado = this.makeTornado()
552:       this.group.add(this.tornado)
553:     }
554: 
555:     if (w === 'flood') {
556:       const waterMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#2d4540', transparent: true, opacity: 0.5, depthWrite: false })
557:       const water = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(420, 420), waterMat)
558:       water.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2
559:       water.position.y = -0.18
560:       this.group.add(water)
561:       this.water = water
562:       this.addDisposable(water)
563:     }
564: 
565:     if (w === 'quicksand') {
566:       const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = c.height = 128
567:       const x = c.getContext('2d')
568:       x.fillStyle = '#5a4325'; x.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128)
569:       for (let i = 0; i < 48; i++) {
570:         x.fillStyle = `rgba(${90 + r() * 60},${65 + r() * 40},${25 + r() * 30},0.5)`
571:         x.beginPath(); x.arc(r() * 128, r() * 128, 3 + r() * 14, 0, 7); x.fill()
572:       }
573:       const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c)
574:       const mat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: tex, color: '#c0a06a' })
575:       const q = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(420, 420), mat)
576:       q.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; q.position.y = -0.55
577:       this.group.add(q); this.quicksand = q
578:       this.addDisposable(q)
579:     }
580: 
581:     if (w === 'clear' || w === 'cloudy') {
582:       // ash motes / heat shimmer
583:       const count = 160
584:       const arr = new Float32Array(count * 3)

## Objective
- Adapt HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE’s graphics toward Slipface’s off-road racing aesthetic while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.
- Save check screenshots as small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Infer Slipface’s style as rugged off-road racing with deformable terrain; no reference screenshots or assets were found in the repository.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected key UI, menu, terrain, car, and race source files, plus `package.json` and the repository file listing.
- Confirmed no implementation changes or screenshots have been made yet.

### Active
- Assess the existing visuals and choose an off-road racing direction.
- Implement visual changes and verify with a build and screenshot.

### Blocked
- No external Slipface references are available; the style must be inferred.

## Next Move
1. Inspect remaining relevant assets and screens, especially the car, terrain, and menu presentation.
2. Apply an off-road racing visual direction while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.
3. Build, capture a JPEG within the specified viewport limit, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `src/styles.css`: Main UI styling.
- `src/app.js`: Screen rendering and UI.
- `src/menu-bg.js`: Procedural menu backdrop.
- `src/track.js`: Track and terrain visuals.
- `src/car.js`: Vehicle visuals.
- `src/race.js`: Gameplay rendering.
- `package.json`: Build scripts.

## Important Context
- HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE is an apocalyptic racing RPG.
- No changes or screenshots have been made yet.

207:   buildRoad() {
208:     const { samples, width } = this
209:     const roadW = width
210:     const landW = 66
211:     const positions = [], uvs = [], indices = []
212:     const landPos = [], landIdx = []
213:     for (let i = 0; i <= N_SAMPLES; i++) {
214:       const s = samples[i % N_SAMPLES]
215:       const y = s.p.y
216:       const lx = s.p.x - s.right.x * roadW / 2, lz = s.p.z - s.right.z * roadW / 2
217:       const rx = s.p.x + s.right.x * roadW / 2, rz = s.p.z + s.right.z * roadW / 2
218:       positions.push(lx, y + 0.06, lz, rx, y + 0.06, rz)
219:       const v = i * (this.length / N_SAMPLES) / 7
220:       uvs.push(0, v, 1, v)
221:       // land: outer low, inner high
222:       landPos.push(
223:         s.p.x - s.right.x * landW, y - 0.6, s.p.z - s.right.z * landW,
224:         s.p.x - s.right.x * (roadW / 2 + 0.7), y - 0.02, s.p.z - s.right.z * (roadW / 2 + 0.7),
225:         s.p.x + s.right.x * (roadW / 2 + 0.7), y - 0.02, s.p.z + s.right.z * (roadW / 2 + 0.7),
226:         s.p.x + s.right.x * landW, y - 0.6, s.p.z + s.right.z * landW
227:       )
228:     }
229:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i++) {
230:       const a = i * 2, b = a + 1, c = a + 2, d = a + 3
231:       indices.push(a, b, c, b, d, c)
232:       const l = i * 4
233:       // left slope
234:       landIdx.push(l, l + 1, l + 4, l + 1, l + 5, l + 4)
235:       // center
236:       landIdx.push(l + 1, l + 2, l + 5, l + 2, l + 6, l + 5)
237:       // right slope
238:       landIdx.push(l + 2, l + 3, l + 6, l + 3, l + 7, l + 6)
239:     }
240:     const roadGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
241:     roadGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3))
242:     roadGeo.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2))
243:     roadGeo.setIndex(indices)
244:     roadGeo.computeVertexNormals()
245:     const roadMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: makeRoadTexture(this.terrain), color: '#ffffff' })
246:     const road = new THREE.Mesh(roadGeo, roadMat)
247:     this.group.add(road)
248:     this.road = road
249:     this.addDisposable(road)
250: 
251:     const landGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
252:     landGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(landPos, 3))
253:     landGeo.setIndex(landIdx)
254:     landGeo.computeVertexNormals()
255:     const landMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(this.terrain.ground), flatShading: true })
256:     const land = new THREE.Mesh(landGeo, landMat)
257:     this.group.add(land)
258:     this.land = land
259:     this.addDisposable(land)
260: 
261:     // edge markers / barrier posts (instanced)
262:     const postGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.18, 0.9, 0.18)
263:     const postMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(this.terrain.accent).multiplyScalar(0.55) })
264:     const posts = new THREE.InstancedMesh(postGeo, postMat, Math.floor(N_SAMPLES / 10) * 2)
265:     const dummy = new THREE.Object3D()
266:     let pi = 0
267:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i += 10) {
268:       const s = samples[i]
269:       for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
270:         dummy.position.set(s.p.x + s.right.x * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.2), s.p.y + 0.45, s.p.z + s.right.z * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.2))
271:         dummy.rotation.y = Math.atan2(s.tan.x, s.tan.z)
272:         dummy.updateMatrix()
273:         posts.setMatrixAt(pi++, dummy.matrix)
274:       }
275:     }
276:     posts.count = pi
277:     this.group.add(posts)
278:     this.addDisposable(posts)
279: 
280:     // glowing reflectors
281:     const refGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.16, 6, 5)
282:     const refMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: this.terrain.accent })
283:     const refs = new THREE.InstancedMesh(refGeo, refMat, 80)
284:     let ri = 0
285:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i += 20) {
286:       const s = samples[i]
287:       for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
288:         dummy.position.set(s.p.x + s.right.x * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.25), s.p.y + 1.02, s.p.z + s.right.z * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.25))
289:         dummy.rotation.set(0, 0, 0)
290:         dummy.updateMatrix()
291:         refs.setMatrixAt(ri++, dummy.matrix)
292:       }
293:     }
294:     refs.count = ri
295:     this.group.add(refs)
296:     this.addDisposable(refs)
297:   }

347:   propPositions(count, min = 18, max = 55) {
348:     const out = []
349:     const r = this.rand
350:     for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
351:       const i = Math.floor(r() * N_SAMPLES)
352:       const s = this.samples[i]
353:       const side = r() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1
354:       const lateral = min + r() * (max - min)
355:       const baseY = lateral < 36 ? s.p.y - 0.15 : -0.5
356:       out.push({
357:         x: s.p.x + s.right.x * side * lateral,
358:         y: baseY,
359:         z: s.p.z + s.right.z * side * lateral,
360:         rot: r() * Math.PI * 2,
361:         scale: 0.7 + r() * 1.2,
362:         tangent: s.tan,
363:         side
364:       })
365:     }
366:     return out
367:   }

369:   buildInstanced(geo, material, points, mapFn) {
370:     if (!points.length) return null
371:     const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, material, points.length)
372:     const dummy = new THREE.Object3D()
373:     points.forEach((p, i) => {
374:       mapFn(dummy, p, i)
375:       dummy.updateMatrix()
376:       mesh.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix)
377:     })
378:     this.group.add(mesh)
379:     this.addDisposable(mesh)
380:     return mesh
381:   }

## Objective
- Adapt HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE’s graphics toward Slipface’s off-road racing aesthetic while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.
- Save check screenshots as small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Infer Slipface’s style as rugged off-road racing with deformable terrain; no reference screenshots or assets were found in the repository.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected key UI, menu, terrain, car, and race source files, plus `package.json`.
- No implementation changes or screenshots have been made yet.

### Active
- Assess the existing visuals and choose an off-road racing direction.
- Implement visual changes and verify with a build and screenshot.

### Blocked
- No external Slipface references are available; the style must be inferred.

## Next Move
1. Inspect remaining relevant assets and screens, especially the car, terrain, and menu presentation.
2. Apply an off-road racing visual direction while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.
3. Build, capture a JPEG within the specified viewport limit, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `src/styles.css`: Main UI styling.
- `src/app.js`: Screen rendering and UI.
- `src/menu-bg.js`: Procedural menu backdrop.
- `src/track.js`: Track and terrain visuals.
- `src/car.js`: Vehicle visuals.
- `src/race.js`: Gameplay rendering.
- `package.json`: Build scripts.

## Important Context
- HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE is an apocalyptic racing RPG.

## Objective
- Adapt HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE’s graphics toward Slipface’s off-road racing aesthetic while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.
- Save check screenshots as small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Infer Slipface’s style as rugged off-road racing with deformable terrain; no reference screenshots or assets were found in the repository.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected project files and `package.json`, including `src/styles.css`, `src/app.js`, and `src/menu-bg.js`.

### Active
- Assess the existing visuals and choose an off-road racing direction.
- Implement visual changes and verify with a build and screenshot.

### Blocked
- No external Slipface references are available; the style must be inferred.

## Next Move
1. Inspect remaining relevant assets and screens, especially the car, terrain, and menu presentation.
2. Apply an off-road racing visual direction while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.
3. Build, capture a JPEG within the specified viewport limit, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `src/styles.css`: Main UI styling.
- `src/app.js`: Screen rendering and UI.
- `src/menu-bg.js`: Procedural menu backdrop.
- `src/track.js`: Track and terrain visuals.
- `src/car.js`: Vehicle visuals.
- `src/race.js`: Gameplay rendering.
- `package.json`: Build scripts.

## Important Context
- HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE is an apocalyptic racing RPG.
- No implementation changes or screenshots have been made yet.

347:   propPositions(count, min = 18, max = 55) {
348:     const out = []
349:     const r = this.rand
350:     for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
351:       const i = Math.floor(r() * N_SAMPLES)
352:       const s = this.samples[i]
353:       const side = r() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1
354:       const lateral = min + r() * (max - min)
355:       const baseY = lateral < 36 ? s.p.y - 0.15 : -0.5
356:       out.push({
357:         x: s.p.x + s.right.x * side * lateral,
358:         y: baseY,
359:         z: s.p.z + s.right.z * side * lateral,
360:         rot: r() * Math.PI * 2,
361:         scale: 0.7 + r() * 1.2,
362:         tangent: s.tan,
363:         side
364:       })
365:     }
366:     return out
367:   }

369:   buildInstanced(geo, material, points, mapFn) {
370:     if (!points.length) return null
371:     const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, material, points.length)
372:     const dummy = new THREE.Object3D()
373:     points.forEach((p, i) => {
374:       mapFn(dummy, p, i)
375:       dummy.updateMatrix()
376:       mesh.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix)
377:     })
378:     this.group.add(mesh)
379:     this.addDisposable(mesh)
380:     return mesh
381:   }

523:   buildWeather() {

528:     this.water = null
529:     this.quicksand = null
530:     this.flash = 0
531:     this.nextStrike = 6
532: 
533:     if (w === 'acid' || w === 'storm' || w === 'hurricane') {
534:       const count = this.quality === 'low' ? 600 : 1300
535:       const arr = new Float32Array(count * 3)
536:       for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
537:         arr[i * 3] = (r() - 0.5) * 100
538:         arr[i * 3 + 1] = r() * 45
539:         arr[i * 3 + 2] = (r() - 0.5) * 100
540:       }
541:       const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(arr, 3))
542:       const col = w === 'acid' ? '#8fdc5a' : w === 'storm' ? '#a8bfd8' : '#93b9c2'
543:       this.rain = new THREE.Points(geo, new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color: col, size: 0.12, transparent: true, opacity: 0.55, depthWrite: false }))
544:       this.rain.frustumCulled = false
545:       this.group.add(this.rain)

549: 
550:     if (w === 'twister') {

552:       this.group.add(this.tornado)

554: 
555:     if (w === 'flood') {
556:       const waterMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#2d4540', transparent: true, opacity: 0.5, depthWrite: false })
557:       const water = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(420, 420), waterMat)

565:     if (w === 'quicksand') {
566:       const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = c.height = 128
567:       const x = c.getContext('2d')
568:       x.fillStyle = '#5a4325'; x.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128)
569:       for (let i = 0; i < 48; i++) {
570:         x.fillStyle = `rgba(${90 + r() * 60},${65 + r() * 40},${25 + r() * 30},0.5)`
571:         x.beginPath(); x.arc(r() * 128, r() * 128, 3 + r() * 14, 0, 7); x.fill()
572:       }
573:       const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c)
574:       const mat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: tex, color: '#c0a06a' })
575:       const q = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(420, 420), mat)
576:       q.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; q.position.y = -0.55
577:       this.group.add(q); this.quicksand = q
578:       this.addDisposable(q)
579:     }
580: 
581:     if (w === 'clear' || w === 'cloudy') {
582:       // ash motes / heat shimmer
583:       const count = 160
584:       const arr = new Float32Array(count * 3)
585:       for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) { arr[i * 3] = (r() - 0.5) * 90; arr[i * 3 + 1] = r() * 20; arr[i * 3 + 2] = (r() - 0.5) * 90 }
586:       const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(arr, 3))
587:       this.ash = new THREE.Points(geo, new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color: w === 'clear' ? '#e6b27c' : '#9c948c', size: 0.1, transparent: true, opacity: 0.4, depthWrite: false }))
588:       this.group.add(this.ash); this.addDisposable(this.ash)

595:     this.boltMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0xe6f0ff, transparent: true, opacity: 0 })

606:   makeTornado() {
607:     const g = new THREE.Group()
608:     const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#8c7b65', transparent: true, opacity: 0.2, side: THREE.DoubleSide, depthWrite: false })
609:     const rings = []
610:     for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
611:       const ring = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.2 + i * 1.4, 2.4 + i * 2.3, 7, 16, 1, true), mat)

## Objective
- Adapt HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE’s graphics toward Slipface’s off-road racing aesthetic while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.
- Save check screenshots as small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Infer Slipface’s style as rugged off-road racing with deformable terrain; no reference screenshots or assets were found in the repository.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected project structure and relevant source files, including styles, menu backdrop, track, car, race, app, and package scripts.

### Active
- Choose and implement an off-road racing visual direction.
- Verify with a build and screenshot.

### Blocked
- No external Slipface references are available; the style must be inferred.

## Next Move
1. Inspect remaining visuals and screens, especially the car, terrain, and menu presentation.
2. Apply the off-road racing visual direction while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.
3. Build, capture a JPEG at a viewport no wider than 1280px, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `src/styles.css`: Main UI styling.
- `src/app.js`: Screen rendering and UI.
- `src/menu-bg.js`: Procedural menu backdrop.
- `src/track.js`: Track and terrain visuals.
- `src/car.js`: Vehicle visuals.
- `src/race.js`: Gameplay rendering.
- `package.json`: Build scripts.

## Important Context
- HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE is an apocalyptic racing RPG.
- No implementation changes or screenshots have been made yet.

347:   propPositions(count, min = 18, max = 55) {
348:     const out = []
349:     const r = this.rand
350:     for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
351:       const i = Math.floor(r() * N_SAMPLES)
352:       const s = this.samples[i]
353:       const side = r() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1
354:       const lateral = min + r() * (max - min)
355:       const baseY = lateral < 36 ? s.p.y - 0.15 : -0.5
356:       out.push({
357:         x: s.p.x + s.right.x * side * lateral,
358:         y: baseY,
359:         z: s.p.z + s.right.z * side * lateral,
360:         rot: r() * Math.PI * 2,
361:         scale: 0.7 + r() * 1.2,
362:         tangent: s.tan,
363:         side
364:       })
365:     }
366:     return out
367:   }

369:   buildInstanced(geo, material, points, mapFn) {
370:     if (!points.length) return null
371:     const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, material, points.length)
372:     const dummy = new THREE.Object3D()
373:     points.forEach((p, i) => {
374:       mapFn(dummy, p, i)
375:       dummy.updateMatrix()
376:       mesh.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix)
377:     })
378:     this.group.add(mesh)
379:     this.addDisposable(mesh)
380:     return mesh
381:   }

531:     this.nextStrike = 6
532: 
533:     if (w === 'acid' || w === 'storm' || w === 'hurricane') {
534:       const count = this.quality === 'low' ? 600 : 1300
535:       const arr = new Float32Array(count * 3)
536:       for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
537:         arr[i * 3] = (r() - 0.5) * 100
538:         arr[i * 3 + 1] = r() * 45
539:         arr[i * 3 + 2] = (r() - 0.5) * 100
540:       }
541:       const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(arr, 3))
542:       const col = w === 'acid' ? '#8fdc5a' : w === 'storm' ? '#a8bfd8' : '#93b9c2'
543:       this.rain = new THREE.Points(geo, new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color: col, size: 0.12, transparent: true, opacity: 0.55, depthWrite: false }))

549: 
550:     if (w === 'twister') {

554: 
555:     if (w === 'flood') {

568:       x.fillStyle = '#5a4325'; x.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128)
569:       for (let i = 0; i < 48; i++) {

581:     if (w === 'clear' || w === 'cloudy') {

586:       const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(arr, 3))
587:       this.ash = new THREE.Points(geo, new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color: w === 'clear' ? '#e6b27c' : '#9c948c', size: 0.1, transparent: true, opacity: 0.4, depthWrite: false }))
588:       this.group.add(this.ash); this.addDisposable(this.ash)

## Objective
- Adapt HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE’s graphics toward Slipface’s off-road racing aesthetic while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.
- Save check screenshots as small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Infer Slipface’s style as rugged off-road racing with deformable terrain; no reference screenshots or assets were found in the repository.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant project files for styles, menu backdrop, track, car, and race; reviewed `package.json`.

### Active
- Choose and implement an off-road racing visual direction.
- Verify with a build and screenshot.

### Blocked
- No external Slipface references are available; the style must be inferred.

## Next Move
1. Inspect remaining visuals and screens, especially the car, terrain, and menu presentation.
2. Apply the off-road racing visual direction while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.
3. Build, capture a JPEG at a viewport no wider than 1280px, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `src/styles.css`: Main UI styling.
- `src/app.js`: Screen rendering and UI.
- `src/menu-bg.js`: Procedural menu backdrop.
- `src/track.js`: Track and terrain visuals.
- `src/car.js`: Vehicle visuals.
- `src/race.js`: Gameplay rendering.
- `package.json`: Build scripts.

## Important Context
- HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE is an apocalyptic racing RPG.
- No implementation changes or screenshots have been made yet.

624:   nearest(pos, hint = 0, window = 46) {
625:     let best = -1, bestD = Infinity
626:     const start = hint - window, end = hint + window
627:     for (let k = start; k <= end; k++) {
628:       const i = ((k % N_SAMPLES) + N_SAMPLES) % N_SAMPLES
629:       const s = this.samples[i]
630:       const dx = pos.x - s.p.x, dz = pos.z - s.p.z
631:       const d = dx * dx + dz * dz
632:       if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = i }
633:     }
634:     if (bestD > 900) {
635:       for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i += 8) {
636:         const s = this.samples[i]
637:         const dx = pos.x - s.p.x, dz = pos.z - s.p.z
638:         const d = dx * dx + dz * dz
639:         if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = i }
640:       }
641:     }
642:     const s = this.samples[best]
643:     const dx = pos.x - s.p.x, dz = pos.z - s.p.z
644:     const lateral = dx * s.right.x + dz * s.right.z
645:     return { index: best, distance: Math.sqrt(bestD), lateral, sample: s }
646:   }

- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.

28:     x.fillRect(r() * 256, r() * 512, 1 + r() * 3, 1 + r() * 2)
29:   }
30:   // cracks
31:   x.strokeStyle = 'rgba(4,4,5,0.45)'

34:     let px = r() * 256, py = r() * 512
35:     x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(px, py)
36:     for (let j = 0; j < 5; j++) { px += (r() - 0.5) * 26; py += 10 + r() * 30; x.lineTo(px, py) }
37:     x.stroke()

42:   x.fillRect(241, 0, 3, 512)

45:   for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) x.fillRect(125, i * 86 + 12, 6, 50)
46:   // oil / blood stains
47:   x.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,7,6,0.22)'
48:   for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { x.beginPath(); x.ellipse(r() * 256, r() * 512, 6 + r() * 24, 4 + r() * 13, r() * 3, 0, 7); x.fill() }
49:   const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c)
50:   tex.wrapS = tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping
51:   tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace
52:   tex.anisotropy = 4

86:       void main(){ float h = clamp(normalize(vPos).y * 1.4 + 0.15, 0.0, 1.0); vec3 c = mix(horizonColor, topColor, pow(h, 0.72)); gl_FragColor = vec4(c, 1.0); }`,

96: export class Track {
97:   constructor({ terrain = 'wasteland', weather = 'cloudy', seed = 1, quality = 'medium' } = {}) {
98:     this.terrain = TERRAINS.find(t => t.id === terrain) || TERRAINS[0]
99:     this.weather = WEATHERS.find(w => w.id === weather) || WEATHERS[0]
100:     this.seed = seed
101:     this.quality = quality
102:     this.rand = rng(seed * 7919 + this.terrain.id.length * 131 + this.weather.id.length * 17)
103:     this.width = 15.5
104:     this.group = new THREE.Group()
105:     this.t = 0
106:     this.buildCurve()
107:     this.buildEnvironment()
108:     this.buildRoad()
109:     this.buildGate()
110:     this.buildProps()
111:     this.buildWeather()
112:   }
113: 
114:   buildCurve() {
115:     const r = this.rand
116:     const count = 11
117:     const pts = []
118:     const baseR = 100 + r() * 36
119:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
120:       const a = (i / count) * Math.PI * 2 + (r() - 0.5) * 0.2
121:       const radius = baseR * (0.72 + r() * 0.63)
122:       const elev = (this.terrain.elevation || 2) * (0.4 + 0.6 * Math.sin(a * 3 + r() * 0.7)) * (this.terrain.id === 'mountains' || this.terrain.id === 'volcano' ? 1 : 0.35)
123:       pts.push(new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(a) * radius, elev, Math.sin(a) * radius))
124:     }
125:     pts.push(pts[0].clone())
126:     this.curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts, true, 'catmullrom', 0.5)
127:     this.samples = []
128:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i++) {
129:       const t = i / N_SAMPLES
130:       const p = this.curve.getPointAt(t)
131:       const tan = this.curve.getTangentAt(t)
132:       tan.y = 0
133:       tan.normalize()
134:       const right = new THREE.Vector3(-tan.z, 0, tan.x)
135:       this.samples.push({ p, tan, right })
136:     }
137:     // smooth surface height to avoid nausea
138:     const raw = this.samples.map(s => s.p.y)
139:     for (let iter = 0; iter < 3; iter++) {
140:       for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i++) {
141:         const a = raw[(i - 1 + N_SAMPLES) % N_SAMPLES], b = raw[i], c = raw[(i + 1) % N_SAMPLES]
142:         raw[i] = (a + b * 2 + c) / 4
143:       }
144:     }
145:     this.computeLength()
146:     this.samples.forEach((s, i) => { s.p.y = raw[i] })
147:   }
148: 
149:   computeLength() {
150:     let len = 0
151:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i++) {
152:       const a = this.samples[i].p, b = this.samples[(i + 1) % N_SAMPLES].p
153:       len += a.distanceTo(b)
154:     }
155:     this.length = len
156:   }
157: 
158:   buildEnvironment() {
159:     const t = this.terrain, w = this.weather
160:     this.skyColor = new THREE.Color(t.sky)
161:     this.horizonColor = new THREE.Color(t.horizon).lerp(new THREE.Color(w.tint), 0.25)
162:     this.fogColor = new THREE.Color(t.fog).lerp(new THREE.Color(w.tint), 0.35)
163:     this.skyMat = makeSkyMaterial('#' + this.skyColor.getHexString(), '#' + this.horizonColor.getHexString())
164:     this.sky = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(450, 24, 12), this.skyMat)
165:     this.group.add(this.sky)
166: 
167:     const sun = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(55, 55), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: makeSunTexture(), transparent: true, depthWrite: false, fog: false }))
168:     sun.position.set(-140, 90, -210)
169:     sun.lookAt(0, 0, 0)
170:     this.group.add(sun)
171:     this.sun = sun
172: 
173:     const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xa4b5c8, new THREE.Color(t.ground).multiplyScalar(0.38), 0.9)
174:     this.group.add(hemi)
175:     this.hemi = hemi
176:     const dir = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffb27a, 1.35)
177:     dir.position.set(-60, 90, -40)
178:     this.group.add(dir)
179:     this.dir = dir
180:     const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x7890b8, 0.5)
181:     fill.position.set(40, 30, 60)
182:     this.group.add(fill)
183: 
184:     // ground
185:     const ground = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(600, 600, 1, 1), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(t.ground).multiplyScalar(0.7) }))
186:     ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2
187:     ground.position.y = -0.6
188:     this.group.add(ground)
189:     this.ground = ground
190: 
191:     // distant mountain ring
192:     const r = this.rand
193:     const ringMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(t.ground).lerp(this.fogColor, 0.55), flatShading: true })
194:     for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
195:       const a = (i / 26) * Math.PI * 2 + r() * 0.15
196:       const dist = 220 + r() * 80
197:       const h = 30 + r() * 85
198:       const cone = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(24 + r() * 40, h, 5 + Math.floor(r() * 2)), ringMat)
199:       cone.position.set(Math.cos(a) * dist, h * 0.34 - 4, Math.sin(a) * dist)
200:       cone.rotation.y = r() * 3
201:       this.group.add(cone)
202:       this.addDisposable(cone)
203:     }
204:     this.addDisposable(ground)
205:   }
206: 
207:   buildRoad() {
208:     const { samples, width } = this
209:     const roadW = width
210:     const landW = 66
211:     const positions = [], uvs = [], indices = []
212:     const landPos = [], landIdx = []
213:     for (let i = 0; i <= N_SAMPLES; i++) {
214:       const s = samples[i % N_SAMPLES]
215:       const y = s.p.y
216:       const lx = s.p.x - s.right.x * roadW / 2, lz = s.p.z - s.right.z * roadW / 2
217:       const rx = s.p.x + s.right.x * roadW / 2, rz = s.p.z + s.right.z * roadW / 2
218:       positions.push(lx, y + 0.06, lz, rx, y + 0.06, rz)
219:       const v = i * (this.length / N_SAMPLES) / 7
220:       uvs.push(0, v, 1, v)
221:       // land: outer low, inner high
222:       landPos.push(
223:         s.p.x - s.right.x * landW, y - 0.6, s.p.z - s.right.z * landW,
224:         s.p.x - s.right.x * (roadW / 2 + 0.7), y - 0.02, s.p.z - s.right.z * (roadW / 2 + 0.7),
225:         s.p.x + s.right.x * (roadW / 2 + 0.7), y - 0.02, s.p.z + s.right.z * (roadW / 2 + 0.7),
226:         s.p.x + s.right.x * landW, y - 0.6, s.p.z + s.right.z * landW
227:       )
228:     }
229:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i++) {
230:       const a = i * 2, b = a + 1, c = a + 2, d = a + 3
231:       indices.push(a, b, c, b, d, c)
232:       const l = i * 4
233:       // left slope
234:       landIdx.push(l, l + 1, l + 4, l + 1, l + 5, l + 4)
235:       // center
236:       landIdx.push(l + 1, l + 2, l + 5, l + 2, l + 6, l + 5)
237:       // right slope
238:       landIdx.push(l + 2, l + 3, l + 6, l + 3, l + 7, l + 6)
239:     }
240:     const roadGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
241:     roadGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3))
242:     roadGeo.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2))
243:     roadGeo.setIndex(indices)
244:     roadGeo.computeVertexNormals()
245:     const roadMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: makeRoadTexture(this.terrain), color: '#ffffff' })
246:     const road = new THREE.Mesh(roadGeo, roadMat)
247:     this.group.add(road)
248:     this.road = road
249:     this.addDisposable(road)
250: 
251:     const landGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
252:     landGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(landPos, 3))
253:     landGeo.setIndex(landIdx)
254:     landGeo.computeVertexNormals()
255:     const landMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(this.terrain.ground), flatShading: true })
256:     const land = new THREE.Mesh(landGeo, landMat)
257:     this.group.add(land)
258:     this.land = land
259:     this.addDisposable(land)
260: 
261:     // edge markers / barrier posts (instanced)
262:     const postGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.18, 0.9, 0.18)
263:     const postMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(this.terrain.accent).multiplyScalar(0.55) })
264:     const posts = new THREE.InstancedMesh(postGeo, postMat, Math.floor(N_SAMPLES / 10) * 2)
265:     const dummy = new THREE.Object3D()
266:     let pi = 0
267:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i += 10) {
268:       const s = samples[i]
269:       for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
270:         dummy.position.set(s.p.x + s.right.x * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.2), s.p.y + 0.45, s.p.z + s.right.z * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.2))
271:         dummy.rotation.y = Math.atan2(s.tan.x, s.tan.z)
272:         dummy.updateMatrix()
273:         posts.setMatrixAt(pi++, dummy.matrix)
274:       }
275:     }
276:     posts.count = pi
277:     this.group.add(posts)
278:     this.addDisposable(posts)
279: 
280:     // glowing reflectors
281:     const refGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.16, 6, 5)
282:     const refMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: this.terrain.accent })
283:     const refs = new THREE.InstancedMesh(refGeo, refMat, 80)
284:     let ri = 0
285:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i += 20) {
286:       const s = samples[i]
287:       for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
288:         dummy.position.set(s.p.x + s.right.x * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.25), s.p.y + 1.02, s.p.z + s.right.z * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.25))
289:         dummy.rotation.set(0, 0, 0)
290:         dummy.updateMatrix()
291:         refs.setMatrixAt(ri++, dummy.matrix)
292:       }
293:     }
294:     refs.count = ri
295:     this.group.add(refs)
296:     this.addDisposable(refs)
297:   }
298: 
299:   buildGate() {
300:     const s = this.samples[0]
301:     const yaw = Math.atan2(s.tan.x, s.tan.z)
302:     const gate = new THREE.Group()
303:     gate.position.copy(s.p)
304:     gate.rotation.y = yaw
305:     const metal = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#24211f' })
306:     const red = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#8f171b' })
307:     for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
308:       const pillar = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.05, 8, 1.05), metal)
309:       pillar.position.set(side * 10.5, 4, 0)
310:       gate.add(pillar)
311:       const cap = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.72, 1.2, 4), red)
312:       cap.position.set(side * 10.5, 8.6, 0); cap.rotation.y = Math.PI / 4
313:       gate.add(cap)
314:     }
315:     const banner = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(21, 3.1, 0.32), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: makeBannerTexture() }))
316:     banner.position.set(0, 7.3, 0)
317:     gate.add(banner)
318:     // checkers on the ground
319:     const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 256; c.height = 64
320:     const cx = c.getContext('2d')
321:     for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) { cx.fillStyle = (i + j) % 2 ? '#e7ddc3' : '#171313'; cx.fillRect(i * 16, j * 16, 16, 16) }
322:     const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c); tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace
323:     const line = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(this.width, 3.2), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: tex }))
324:     line.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2
325:     line.position.y = 0.1
326:     gate.add(line)
327:     this.group.add(gate)
328:     this.gate = gate
329: 
330:     // start lights on gate
331:     this.startLights = []
332:     for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
333:       const l = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.28, 8, 6), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#3a1010' }))
334:       l.position.set(-1.8 + i * 1.8, 5.55, 0.25)
335:       gate.add(l)
336:       this.startLights.push(l)
337:     }
338:   }

340:   buildProps() {
341:     const kind = this.terrain.props
342:     for (const k of kind) this.buildProp(k)
343:     // roadside wreck clusters
344:     if (!kind.includes('wreck')) this.buildProp('wreck')
345:   }
346: 
347:   propPositions(count, min = 18, max = 55) {
348:     const out = []
349:     const r = this.rand
350:     for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
351:       const i = Math.floor(r() * N_SAMPLES)
352:       const s = this.samples[i]
353:       const side = r() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1
354:       const lateral = min + r() * (max - min)
355:       const baseY = lateral < 36 ? s.p.y - 0.15 : -0.5
356:       out.push({
357:         x: s.p.x + s.right.x * side * lateral,
358:         y: baseY,
359:         z: s.p.z + s.right.z * side * lateral,
360:         rot: r() * Math.PI * 2,
361:         scale: 0.7 + r() * 1.2,
362:         tangent: s.tan,
363:         side
364:       })
365:     }
366:     return out
367:   }
368: 
369:   buildInstanced(geo, material, points, mapFn) {
370:     if (!points.length) return null
371:     const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, material, points.length)
372:     const dummy = new THREE.Object3D()
373:     points.forEach((p, i) => {
374:       mapFn(dummy, p, i)
375:       dummy.updateMatrix()
376:       mesh.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix)
377:     })
378:     this.group.add(mesh)
379:     this.addDisposable(mesh)
380:     return mesh
381:   }
382: 
383:   buildProp(kind) {
384:     const t = this.terrain
385:     const baseCol = new THREE.Color(t.ground)
386:     const accent = new THREE.Color(t.accent)
387:     const rockMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: baseCol.clone().multiplyScalar(0.75), flatShading: true })
388:     const darkMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: baseCol.clone().multiplyScalar(0.35), flatShading: true })
389:     const metalMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#2b2927', flatShading: true })
390:     const boneMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#bdb198', flatShading: true })
391:     const acMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: accent })
392:     const pts = this.propPositions(kind === 'mountain' ? 14 : 34, kind === 'mountain' ? 40 : 17, kind === 'mountain' ? 100 : 62)
393: 
394:     if (kind === 'rock') {
395:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(1, 0), rockMat, pts, (d, p) => {
396:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 0.6, p.z)
397:         d.rotation.set(p.rot, p.rot * 1.4, p.rot * 0.4)
398:         d.scale.set(p.scale * 2.2, p.scale * 1.5, p.scale * 2)
399:       })
400:     } else if (kind === 'mountain') {
401:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.ConeGeometry(1, 1, 5), rockMat, pts, (d, p) => {
402:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 5, p.z)
403:         d.scale.set(p.scale * 18, p.scale * 18, p.scale * 18)
404:         d.rotation.y = p.rot
405:       })
406:     } else if (kind === 'dune') {
407:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 7, 5), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: baseCol.clone().multiplyScalar(1.15) }), pts, (d, p) => {
408:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y - p.scale * 0.7, p.z)
409:         d.scale.set(p.scale * 9, p.scale * 2.5, p.scale * 7)
410:       })
411:     } else if (kind === 'pine') {
412:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.28, 0.38, 4, 5), darkMat, pts, (d, p) => {
413:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 2, p.z); d.scale.setScalar(p.scale); d.rotation.y = p.rot
414:       })
415:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.ConeGeometry(2.4, 7, 6), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(t.ground).multiplyScalar(0.6), flatShading: true }), pts, (d, p) => {
416:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 5.4, p.z); d.scale.set(p.scale * 1.3, p.scale * 1.6, p.scale * 1.3); d.rotation.y = p.rot
417:       })
418:     } else if (kind === 'tree' || kind === 'palm') {
419:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.35, 0.55, 6, 5), darkMat, pts, (d, p) => {
420:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 3, p.z); d.scale.setScalar(p.scale); d.rotation.z = (p.rot - 3.14) * 0.03
421:       })
422:       const crownCol = new THREE.Color(t.ground).multiplyScalar(0.72).lerp(new THREE.Color(t.accent), 0.18)
423:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(2.4, 0), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: crownCol, flatShading: true }), pts, (d, p) => {
424:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 6.4, p.z)
425:         d.scale.set(p.scale * 1.5, p.scale * (kind === 'palm' ? 0.55 : 1.2), p.scale * 1.5)
426:         d.rotation.y = p.rot
427:       })
428:     } else if (kind === 'cactus') {
429:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.45, 0.55, 4.5, 6), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#4c6138', flatShading: true }), pts, (d, p) => {
430:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 2.2, p.z); d.scale.setScalar(p.scale); d.rotation.y = p.rot
431:       })
432:     } else if (kind === 'fern') {
433:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.ConeGeometry(1.7, 3.2, 5), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#305a2f', flatShading: true }), pts, (d, p) => {
434:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 1.2, p.z); d.scale.setScalar(p.scale); d.rotation.y = p.rot

624:   nearest(pos, hint = 0, window = 46) {
625:     let best = -1, bestD = Infinity
626:     const start = hint - window, end = hint + window
627:     for (let k = start; k <= end; k++) {
628:       const i = ((k % N_SAMPLES) + N_SAMPLES) % N_SAMPLES
629:       const s = this.samples[i]
630:       const dx = pos.x - s.p.x, dz = pos.z - s.p.z
631:       const d = dx * dx + dz * dz
632:       if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = i }
633:     }
634:     if (bestD > 900) {
635:       for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i += 8) {
636:         const s = this.samples[i]
637:         const dx = pos.x - s.p.x, dz = pos.z - s.p.z
638:         const d = dx * dx + dz * dz
639:         if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = i }
640:       }
641:     }
642:     const s = this.samples[best]
643:     const dx = pos.x - s.p.x, dz = pos.z - s.p.z
644:     const lateral = dx * s.right.x + dz * s.right.z
645:     return { index: best, distance: Math.sqrt(bestD), lateral, sample: s }
646:   }

- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.

- HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE is an apocalyptic racing RPG.
- No implementation changes or screenshots have been made yet.

## Objective
- Adapt HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE’s graphics toward Slipface’s off-road racing aesthetic while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.
- Save check screenshots as small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Infer Slipface’s style as rugged off-road racing with deformable terrain; no reference screenshots or assets were found in the repository.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected project structure, `package.json`, styling, menu backdrop, app, track, race, and HTML files.

### Active
- Choose and implement an off-road racing visual direction.
- Verify with a build and screenshot.

### Blocked
- No external Slipface references are available; the style must be inferred.

## Next Move
1. Apply the off-road racing visual direction while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.
2. Build, capture a JPEG at a viewport no wider than 1280px, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `src/styles.css`: Main UI styling.
- `src/app.js`: Screen rendering and UI.
- `src/menu-bg.js`: Procedural menu backdrop.
- `src/track.js`: Track and terrain visuals.
- `src/car.js`: Vehicle visuals.
- `src/race.js`: Gameplay rendering.
- `package.json`: Build scripts.

## Important Context
- HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE is an apocalyptic racing RPG.
- No implementation changes or screenshots have been made yet.

347:   propPositions(count, min = 18, max = 55) {
348:     const out = []
349:     const r = this.rand
350:     for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
351:       const i = Math.floor(r() * N_SAMPLES)
352:       const s = this.samples[i]
353:       const side = r() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1
354:       const lateral = min + r() * (max - min)
355:       const baseY = lateral < 36 ? s.p.y - 0.15 : -0.5
356:       out.push({
357:         x: s.p.x + s.right.x * side * lateral,
358:         y: baseY,
359:         z: s.p.z + s.right.z * side * lateral,
360:         rot: r() * Math.PI * 2,
361:         scale: 0.7 + r() * 1.2,
362:         tangent: s.tan,
363:         side
364:       })
365:     }
366:     return out
367:   }

369:   buildInstanced(geo, material, points, mapFn) {

373:     points.forEach((p, i) => {

375:       dummy.updateMatrix()
376:       mesh.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix)
377:     })
378:     this.group.add(mesh)
379:     this.addDisposable(mesh)
380:     return mesh
381:   }

606:   makeTornado() {
607:     const g = new THREE.Group()
608:     const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#8c7b65', transparent: true, opacity: 0.2, side: THREE.DoubleSide, depthWrite: false })
609:     const rings = []
610:     for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
611:       const ring = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.2 + i * 1.4, 2.4 + i * 2.3, 7, 16, 1, true), mat)
612:       ring.position.y = 3 + i * 5
613:       ring.userData.spin = 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.8
614:       g.add(ring); rings.push(ring)
615:     }
616:     const s = this.samples[Math.floor(this.samples.length * 0.68)]
617:     const side = this.rand() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1
618:     g.position.set(s.p.x + s.right.x * side * 38, s.p.y - 1, s.p.z + s.right.z * side * 38)
619:     g.userData.rings = rings
620:     g.userData.radius = 20
621:     return g
622:   }

624:   nearest(pos, hint = 0, window = 46) {
625:     let best = -1, bestD = Infinity
626:     const start = hint - window, end = hint + window
627:     for (let k = start; k <= end; k++) {
628:       const i = ((k % N_SAMPLES) + N_SAMPLES) % N_SAMPLES
629:       const s = this.samples[i]
630:       const dx = pos.x - s.p.x, dz = pos.z - s.p.z
631:       const d = dx * dx + dz * dz
632:       if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = i }
633:     }
634:     if (bestD > 900) {
635:       for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i += 8) {
636:         const s = this.samples[i]
637:         const dx = pos.x - s.p.x, dz = pos.z - s.p.z
638:         const d = dx * dx + dz * dz
639:         if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = i }
640:       }
641:     }
642:     const s = this.samples[best]
643:     const dx = pos.x - s.p.x, dz = pos.z - s.p.z
644:     const lateral = dx * s.right.x + dz * s.right.z
645:     return { index: best, distance: Math.sqrt(bestD), lateral, sample: s }
646:   }

648:   sampleAt(index) {
649:     return this.samples[((index % N_SAMPLES) + N_SAMPLES) % N_SAMPLES]
650:   }
651: 
652:   worldAt(index, lateral = 0, yOff = 0) {
653:     const s = this.sampleAt(index)
654:     return new THREE.Vector3(s.p.x + s.right.x * lateral, s.p.y + yOff, s.p.z + s.right.z * lateral)
655:   }

657:   startPose(slot = 0) {
658:     // grid behind the start line, staggered rows
659:     const row = Math.floor(slot / 2)
660:     const col = slot % 2
661:     const index = 18 + row * 13
662:     const s = this.sampleAt(index)
663:     const lateral = (col === 0 ? -1 : 1) * 3.6
664:     return {
665:       pos: new THREE.Vector3(s.p.x + s.right.x * lateral, s.p.y + 0.02, s.p.z + s.right.z * lateral),
666:       yaw: Math.atan2(s.tan.x, s.tan.z),
667:       index,
668:       lateral
669:     }
670:   }

## Objective
- Adapt HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE’s graphics toward Slipface’s off-road racing aesthetic while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.
- Save check screenshots as small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Infer Slipface’s style as rugged off-road racing with deformable terrain; no reference screenshots or assets were found in the repository.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected project structure, styling, menu backdrop, app, track, race, and HTML files.

### Active
- Choose and implement an off-road racing visual direction.
- Verify with a build and screenshot.

### Blocked
- No external Slipface references are available; the style must be inferred.

## Next Move
1. Apply the off-road racing visual direction while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.
2. Build, capture a JPEG at a viewport no wider than 1280px, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `src/styles.css`: Main UI styling.
- `src/app.js`: Screen rendering and UI.
- `src/menu-bg.js`: Procedural menu backdrop.
- `src/track.js`: Track and terrain visuals.
- `src/car.js`: Vehicle visuals.
- `src/race.js`: Gameplay rendering.
- `package.json`: Build scripts.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.

## Important Context
- HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE is an apocalyptic racing RPG.
- No implementation changes or screenshots have been made yet.

48:   for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { x.beginPath(); x.ellipse(r() * 256, r() * 512, 6 + r() * 24, 4 + r() * 13, r() * 3, 0, 7); x.fill() }
49:   const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c)
50:   tex.wrapS = tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping
51:   tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace
52:   tex.anisotropy = 4
