207:   buildRoad() {
208:     const { samples, width } = this
209:     const roadW = width
210:     const landW = 66
211:     const positions = [], uvs = [], indices = []
212:     const landPos = [], landIdx = []
213:     for (let i = 0; i <= N_SAMPLES; i++) {
214:       const s = samples[i % N_SAMPLES]
215:       const y = s.p.y
216:       const lx = s.p.x - s.right.x * roadW / 2, lz = s.p.z - s.right.z * roadW / 2
217:       const rx = s.p.x + s.right.x * roadW / 2, rz = s.p.z + s.right.z * roadW / 2
218:       positions.push(lx, y + 0.06, lz, rx, y + 0.06, rz)
219:       const v = i * (this.length / N_SAMPLES) / 7
220:       uvs.push(0, v, 1, v)
221:       // land: outer low, inner high
222:       landPos.push(
223:         s.p.x - s.right.x * landW, y - 0.6, s.p.z - s.right.z * landW,
224:         s.p.x - s.right.x * (roadW / 2 + 0.7), y - 0.02, s.p.z - s.right.z * (roadW / 2 + 0.7),
225:         s.p.x + s.right.x * (roadW / 2 + 0.7), y - 0.02, s.p.z + s.right.z * (roadW / 2 + 0.7),
226:         s.p.x + s.right.x * landW, y - 0.6, s.p.z + s.right.z * landW
227:       )
228:     }
229:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i++) {
230:       const a = i * 2, b = a + 1, c = a + 2, d = a + 3
231:       indices.push(a, b, c, b, d, c)
232:       const l = i * 4
233:       // left slope
234:       landIdx.push(l, l + 1, l + 4, l + 1, l + 5, l + 4)
235:       // center
236:       landIdx.push(l + 1, l + 2, l + 5, l + 2, l + 6, l + 5)
237:       // right slope
238:       landIdx.push(l + 2, l + 3, l + 6, l + 3, l + 7, l + 6)
239:     }
240:     const roadGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
241:     roadGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3))
242:     roadGeo.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2))
243:     roadGeo.setIndex(indices)
244:     roadGeo.computeVertexNormals()
245:     const roadMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: makeRoadTexture(this.terrain), color: '#ffffff' })
246:     const road = new THREE.Mesh(roadGeo, roadMat)
247:     this.group.add(road)
248:     this.road = road
249:     this.addDisposable(road)
250: 
251:     const landGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
252:     landGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(landPos, 3))
253:     landGeo.setIndex(landIdx)
254:     landGeo.computeVertexNormals()
255:     const landMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(this.terrain.ground), flatShading: true })
256:     const land = new THREE.Mesh(landGeo, landMat)
257:     this.group.add(land)
258:     this.land = land
259:     this.addDisposable(land)
260: 
261:     // edge markers / barrier posts (instanced)
262:     const postGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.18, 0.9, 0.18)
263:     const postMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(this.terrain.accent).multiplyScalar(0.55) })
264:     const posts = new THREE.InstancedMesh(postGeo, postMat, Math.floor(N_SAMPLES / 10) * 2)
265:     const dummy = new THREE.Object3D()
266:     let pi = 0
267:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i += 10) {
268:       const s = samples[i]
269:       for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
270:         dummy.position.set(s.p.x + s.right.x * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.2), s.p.y + 0.45, s.p.z + s.right.z * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.2))
271:         dummy.rotation.y = Math.atan2(s.tan.x, s.tan.z)
272:         dummy.updateMatrix()
273:         posts.setMatrixAt(pi++, dummy.matrix)
274:       }
275:     }
276:     posts.count = pi
277:     this.group.add(posts)
278:     this.addDisposable(posts)
279: 
280:     // glowing reflectors
281:     const refGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.16, 6, 5)
282:     const refMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: this.terrain.accent })
283:     const refs = new THREE.InstancedMesh(refGeo, refMat, 80)
284:     let ri = 0
285:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i += 20) {
286:       const s = samples[i]
287:       for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
288:         dummy.position.set(s.p.x + s.right.x * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.25), s.p.y + 1.02, s.p.z + s.right.z * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.25))
289:         dummy.rotation.set(0, 0, 0)
290:         dummy.updateMatrix()
291:         refs.setMatrixAt(ri++, dummy.matrix)
292:       }
293:     }
294:     refs.count = ri
295:     this.group.add(refs)
296:     this.addDisposable(refs)
297:   }

299:   buildGate() {
300:     const s = this.samples[0]
301:     const yaw = Math.atan2(s.tan.x, s.tan.z)
302:     const gate = new THREE.Group()
303:     gate.position.copy(s.p)
304:     gate.rotation.y = yaw
305:     const metal = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#24211f' })
306:     const red = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#8f171b' })
307:     for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
308:       const pillar = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.05, 8, 1.05), metal)
309:       pillar.position.set(side * 10.5, 4, 0)
310:       gate.add(pillar)
311:       const cap = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.72, 1.2, 4), red)
312:       cap.position.set(side * 10.5, 8.6, 0); cap.rotation.y = Math.PI / 4
313:       gate.add(cap)
314:     }
315:     const banner = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(21, 3.1, 0.32), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: makeBannerTexture() }))
316:     banner.position.set(0, 7.3, 0)
317:     gate.add(banner)
318:     // checkers on the ground
319:     const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 256; c.height = 64
320:     const cx = c.getContext('2d')
321:     for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) { cx.fillStyle = (i + j) % 2 ? '#e7ddc3' : '#171313'; cx.fillRect(i * 16, j * 16, 16, 16) }
322:     const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c); tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace
323:     const line = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(this.width, 3.2), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: tex }))
324:     line.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2
325:     line.position.y = 0.1
326:     gate.add(line)
327:     this.group.add(gate)
328:     this.gate = gate
329: 
330:     // start lights on gate
331:     this.startLights = []
332:     for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
333:       const l = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.28, 8, 6), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#3a1010' }))
334:       l.position.set(-1.8 + i * 1.8, 5.55, 0.25)
335:       gate.add(l)
336:       this.startLights.push(l)
337:     }
338:   }

340:   buildProps() {

347:   propPositions(count, min = 18, max = 55) {
348:     const out = []
349:     const r = this.rand
350:     for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
351:       const i = Math.floor(r() * N_SAMPLES)
352:       const s = this.samples[i]
353:       const side = r() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1
354:       const lateral = min + r() * (max - min)
355:       const baseY = lateral < 36 ? s.p.y - 0.15 : -0.5
356:       out.push({
357:         x: s.p.x + s.right.x * side * lateral,
358:         y: baseY,
359:         z: s.p.z + s.right.z * side * lateral,
360:         rot: r() * Math.PI * 2,
361:         scale: 0.7 + r() * 1.2,
362:         tangent: s.tan,
363:         side
364:       })
365:     }
366:     return out
367:   }

369:   buildInstanced(geo, material, points, mapFn) {
370:     if (!points.length) return null
371:     const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, material, points.length)
372:     const dummy = new THREE.Object3D()
373:     points.forEach((p, i) => {
374:       mapFn(dummy, p, i)
375:       dummy.updateMatrix()
376:       mesh.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix)
377:     })
378:     this.group.add(mesh)
379:     this.addDisposable(mesh)
380:     return mesh
381:   }

383:   buildProp(kind) {
384:     const t = this.terrain
385:     const baseCol = new THREE.Color(t.ground)
386:     const accent = new THREE.Color(t.accent)
387:     const rockMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: baseCol.clone().multiplyScalar(0.75), flatShading: true })
388:     const darkMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: baseCol.clone().multiplyScalar(0.35), flatShading: true })

390:     const boneMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#bdb198', flatShading: true })
391:     const acMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: accent })
392:     const pts = this.propPositions(kind === 'mountain' ? 14 : 34, kind === 'mountain' ? 40 : 17, kind === 'mountain' ? 100 : 62)
393: 
394:     if (kind === 'rock') {
395:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(1, 0), rockMat, pts, (d, p) => {

397:         d.rotation.set(p.rot, p.rot * 1.4, p.rot * 0.4)
398:         d.scale.set(p.scale * 2.2, p.scale * 1.5, p.scale * 2)
399:       })
400:     } else if (kind === 'mountain') {

402:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 5, p.z)
403:         d.scale.set(p.scale * 18, p.scale * 18, p.scale * 18)

406:     } else if (kind === 'dune') {

408:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y - p.scale * 0.7, p.z)
409:         d.scale.set(p.scale * 9, p.scale * 2.5, p.scale * 7)
410:       })
411:     } else if (kind === 'pine') {

413:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 2, p.z); d.scale.setScalar(p.scale); d.rotation.y = p.rot
414:       })
415:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.ConeGeometry(2.4, 7, 6), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(t.ground).multiplyScalar(0.6), flatShading: true }), pts, (d, p) => {
416:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 5.4, p.z); d.scale.set(p.scale * 1.3, p.scale * 1.6, p.scale * 1.3); d.rotation.y = p.rot
417:       })
418:     } else if (kind === 'tree' || kind === 'palm') {

420:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 3, p.z); d.scale.setScalar(p.scale); d.rotation.z = (p.rot - 3.14) * 0.03
421:       })
422:       const crownCol = new THREE.Color(t.ground).multiplyScalar(0.72).lerp(new THREE.Color(t.accent), 0.18)
423:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(2.4, 0), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: crownCol, flatShading: true }), pts, (d, p) => {
424:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 6.4, p.z)
425:         d.scale.set(p.scale * 1.5, p.scale * (kind === 'palm' ? 0.55 : 1.2), p.scale * 1.5)

428:     } else if (kind === 'cactus') {

430:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 2.2, p.z); d.scale.setScalar(p.scale); d.rotation.y = p.rot

446:       })

450:       })

460:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + 1.6, p.z); d.scale.setScalar(p.scale); d.rotation.y = p.rot
461:       })
462:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.4, 1.6, 0.2), metalMat, pts.filter((_, i) => i % 4 === 0), (d, p) => {
463:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + 1.6, p.z); d.rotation.y = p.rot

466:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.32, 0.5, 10, 4), metalMat, pts, (d, p) => {
467:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 5, p.z); d.scale.setScalar(p.scale); d.rotation.y = p.rot
468:       })
469:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.12, 0.12, 10), darkMat, pts.filter((_, i) => i % 2 === 0), (d, p) => {
470:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 8, p.z); d.rotation.y = p.rot

472:     } else if (kind === 'bones') {

474:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + 0.35, p.z); d.scale.set(p.scale, p.scale * 0.8, p.scale * 1.15); d.rotation.set(p.rot, p.rot, p.rot)
475:       })
476:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.18, 0.18, 5, 5), boneMat, pts.slice(0, 20), (d, p) => {
477:         d.position.set(p.x + 1.5, p.y + 0.2, p.z); d.rotation.set(Math.PI / 2, p.rot, 0)
478:       })

625:     let best = -1, bestD = Infinity
626:     const start = hint - window, end = hint + window
627:     for (let k = start; k <= end; k++) {
628:       const i = ((k % N_SAMPLES) + N_SAMPLES) % N_SAMPLES
629:       const s = this.samples[i]
630:       const dx = pos.x - s.p.x, dz = pos.z - s.p.z
631:       const d = dx * dx + dz * dz
632:       if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = i }
633:     }

636:         const s = this.samples[i]

## Objective
- Adapt HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE’s graphics toward Slipface’s rugged off-road racing aesthetic while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.
- Save check screenshots as small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Infer Slipface’s style as rugged off-road racing with deformable terrain; no reference screenshots or assets were found in the repository.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected UI styling, menu backdrop, track, car, and race code.

### Active
- Choose and implement an off-road racing visual direction.
- Verify with a build and screenshot.

### Blocked
- No external Slipface references are available; the style must be inferred.

## Next Move
1. Apply the off-road racing visual direction while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.
2. Build, capture a JPEG at a viewport no wider than 1280px, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

- `src/styles.css`: Main UI styling.

- `src/race.js`: Gameplay rendering.
- `src/app.js`: Screen rendering and UI.
- `package.json`: Build scripts.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.

## Important Context
- HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE is an apocalyptic racing RPG.
- No implementation changes or screenshots have been made yet.

48:   for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { x.beginPath(); x.ellipse(r() * 256, r() * 512, 6 + r() * 24, 4 + r() * 13, r() * 3, 0, 7); x.fill() }
49:   const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c)
50:   tex.wrapS = tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping
51:   tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace
52:   tex.anisotropy = 4

86:       void main(){ float h = clamp(normalize(vPos).y * 1.4 + 0.15, 0.0, 1.0); vec3 c = mix(horizonColor, topColor, pow(h, 0.72)); gl_FragColor = vec4(c, 1.0); }`,

96: export class Track {
97:   constructor({ terrain = 'wasteland', weather = 'cloudy', seed = 1, quality = 'medium' } = {}) {
98:     this.terrain = TERRAINS.find(t => t.id === terrain) || TERRAINS[0]
99:     this.weather = WEATHERS.find(w => w.id === weather) || WEATHERS[0]
100:     this.seed = seed
101:     this.quality = quality
102:     this.rand = rng(seed * 7919 + this.terrain.id.length * 131 + this.weather.id.length * 17)
103:     this.width = 15.5
104:     this.group = new THREE.Group()
105:     this.t = 0
106:     this.buildCurve()
107:     this.buildEnvironment()
108:     this.buildRoad()
109:     this.buildGate()
110:     this.buildProps()
111:     this.buildWeather()
112:   }
113: 
114:   buildCurve() {
115:     const r = this.rand
116:     const count = 11
117:     const pts = []
118:     const baseR = 100 + r() * 36
119:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
120:       const a = (i / count) * Math.PI * 2 + (r() - 0.5) * 0.2
121:       const radius = baseR * (0.72 + r() * 0.63)
122:       const elev = (this.terrain.elevation || 2) * (0.4 + 0.6 * Math.sin(a * 3 + r() * 0.7)) * (this.terrain.id === 'mountains' || this.terrain.id === 'volcano' ? 1 : 0.35)
123:       pts.push(new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(a) * radius, elev, Math.sin(a) * radius))
124:     }
125:     pts.push(pts[0].clone())
126:     this.curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts, true, 'catmullrom', 0.5)
127:     this.samples = []
128:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i++) {
129:       const t = i / N_SAMPLES
130:       const p = this.curve.getPointAt(t)
131:       const tan = this.curve.getTangentAt(t)
132:       tan.y = 0
133:       tan.normalize()
134:       const right = new THREE.Vector3(-tan.z, 0, tan.x)
135:       this.samples.push({ p, tan, right })
136:     }
137:     // smooth surface height to avoid nausea
138:     const raw = this.samples.map(s => s.p.y)
139:     for (let iter = 0; iter < 3; iter++) {
140:       for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i++) {
141:         const a = raw[(i - 1 + N_SAMPLES) % N_SAMPLES], b = raw[i], c = raw[(i + 1) % N_SAMPLES]
142:         raw[i] = (a + b * 2 + c) / 4
143:       }
144:     }
145:     this.computeLength()
146:     this.samples.forEach((s, i) => { s.p.y = raw[i] })
147:   }
148: 
149:   computeLength() {
150:     let len = 0
151:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i++) {
152:       const a = this.samples[i].p, b = this.samples[(i + 1) % N_SAMPLES].p
153:       len += a.distanceTo(b)
154:     }
155:     this.length = len
156:   }
157: 
158:   buildEnvironment() {
159:     const t = this.terrain, w = this.weather
160:     this.skyColor = new THREE.Color(t.sky)
161:     this.horizonColor = new THREE.Color(t.horizon).lerp(new THREE.Color(w.tint), 0.25)
162:     this.fogColor = new THREE.Color(t.fog).lerp(new THREE.Color(w.tint), 0.35)
163:     this.skyMat = makeSkyMaterial('#' + this.skyColor.getHexString(), '#' + this.horizonColor.getHexString())
164:     this.sky = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(450, 24, 12), this.skyMat)
165:     this.group.add(this.sky)
166: 
167:     const sun = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(55, 55), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: makeSunTexture(), transparent: true, depthWrite: false, fog: false }))
168:     sun.position.set(-140, 90, -210)
169:     sun.lookAt(0, 0, 0)
170:     this.group.add(sun)
171:     this.sun = sun
172: 
173:     const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xa4b5c8, new THREE.Color(t.ground).multiplyScalar(0.38), 0.9)
174:     this.group.add(hemi)
175:     this.hemi = hemi
176:     const dir = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffb27a, 1.35)
177:     dir.position.set(-60, 90, -40)
178:     this.group.add(dir)
179:     this.dir = dir
180:     const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x7890b8, 0.5)
181:     fill.position.set(40, 30, 60)
182:     this.group.add(fill)
183: 
184:     // ground
185:     const ground = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(600, 600, 1, 1), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(t.ground).multiplyScalar(0.7) }))
186:     ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2
187:     ground.position.y = -0.6
188:     this.group.add(ground)
189:     this.ground = ground
190: 
191:     // distant mountain ring
192:     const r = this.rand
193:     const ringMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(t.ground).lerp(this.fogColor, 0.55), flatShading: true })
194:     for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
195:       const a = (i / 26) * Math.PI * 2 + r() * 0.15
196:       const dist = 220 + r() * 80
197:       const h = 30 + r() * 85
198:       const cone = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(24 + r() * 40, h, 5 + Math.floor(r() * 2)), ringMat)
199:       cone.position.set(Math.cos(a) * dist, h * 0.34 - 4, Math.sin(a) * dist)
200:       cone.rotation.y = r() * 3
201:       this.group.add(cone)
202:       this.addDisposable(cone)
203:     }
204:     this.addDisposable(ground)
205:   }
206: 
207:   buildRoad() {
208:     const { samples, width } = this
209:     const roadW = width
210:     const landW = 66
211:     const positions = [], uvs = [], indices = []
212:     const landPos = [], landIdx = []
213:     for (let i = 0; i <= N_SAMPLES; i++) {
214:       const s = samples[i % N_SAMPLES]
215:       const y = s.p.y
216:       const lx = s.p.x - s.right.x * roadW / 2, lz = s.p.z - s.right.z * roadW / 2
217:       const rx = s.p.x + s.right.x * roadW / 2, rz = s.p.z + s.right.z * roadW / 2
218:       positions.push(lx, y + 0.06, lz, rx, y + 0.06, rz)
219:       const v = i * (this.length / N_SAMPLES) / 7
220:       uvs.push(0, v, 1, v)
221:       // land: outer low, inner high
222:       landPos.push(
223:         s.p.x - s.right.x * landW, y - 0.6, s.p.z - s.right.z * landW,
224:         s.p.x - s.right.x * (roadW / 2 + 0.7), y - 0.02, s.p.z - s.right.z * (roadW / 2 + 0.7),
225:         s.p.x + s.right.x * (roadW / 2 + 0.7), y - 0.02, s.p.z + s.right.z * (roadW / 2 + 0.7),
226:         s.p.x + s.right.x * landW, y - 0.6, s.p.z + s.right.z * landW
227:       )
228:     }
229:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i++) {
230:       const a = i * 2, b = a + 1, c = a + 2, d = a + 3
231:       indices.push(a, b, c, b, d, c)
232:       const l = i * 4
233:       // left slope
234:       landIdx.push(l, l + 1, l + 4, l + 1, l + 5, l + 4)
235:       // center
236:       landIdx.push(l + 1, l + 2, l + 5, l + 2, l + 6, l + 5)
237:       // right slope
238:       landIdx.push(l + 2, l + 3, l + 6, l + 3, l + 7, l + 6)
239:     }
240:     const roadGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
241:     roadGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3))
242:     roadGeo.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2))
243:     roadGeo.setIndex(indices)
244:     roadGeo.computeVertexNormals()
245:     const roadMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: makeRoadTexture(this.terrain), color: '#ffffff' })
246:     const road = new THREE.Mesh(roadGeo, roadMat)
247:     this.group.add(road)
248:     this.road = road
249:     this.addDisposable(road)
250: 
251:     const landGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
252:     landGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(landPos, 3))
253:     landGeo.setIndex(landIdx)
254:     landGeo.computeVertexNormals()
255:     const landMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(this.terrain.ground), flatShading: true })
256:     const land = new THREE.Mesh(landGeo, landMat)
257:     this.group.add(land)
258:     this.land = land
259:     this.addDisposable(land)
260: 
261:     // edge markers / barrier posts (instanced)
262:     const postGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.18, 0.9, 0.18)
263:     const postMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(this.terrain.accent).multiplyScalar(0.55) })
264:     const posts = new THREE.InstancedMesh(postGeo, postMat, Math.floor(N_SAMPLES / 10) * 2)
265:     const dummy = new THREE.Object3D()
266:     let pi = 0
267:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i += 10) {
268:       const s = samples[i]
269:       for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
270:         dummy.position.set(s.p.x + s.right.x * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.2), s.p.y + 0.45, s.p.z + s.right.z * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.2))
271:         dummy.rotation.y = Math.atan2(s.tan.x, s.tan.z)
272:         dummy.updateMatrix()
273:         posts.setMatrixAt(pi++, dummy.matrix)
274:       }
275:     }
276:     posts.count = pi
277:     this.group.add(posts)
278:     this.addDisposable(posts)
279: 
280:     // glowing reflectors
281:     const refGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.16, 6, 5)
282:     const refMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: this.terrain.accent })
283:     const refs = new THREE.InstancedMesh(refGeo, refMat, 80)
284:     let ri = 0
285:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i += 20) {
286:       const s = samples[i]
287:       for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
288:         dummy.position.set(s.p.x + s.right.x * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.25), s.p.y + 1.02, s.p.z + s.right.z * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.25))
289:         dummy.rotation.set(0, 0, 0)
290:         dummy.updateMatrix()
291:         refs.setMatrixAt(ri++, dummy.matrix)
292:       }
293:     }
294:     refs.count = ri
295:     this.group.add(refs)
296:     this.addDisposable(refs)
297:   }
298: 
299:   buildGate() {
300:     const s = this.samples[0]
301:     const yaw = Math.atan2(s.tan.x, s.tan.z)
302:     const gate = new THREE.Group()
303:     gate.position.copy(s.p)
304:     gate.rotation.y = yaw
305:     const metal = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#24211f' })
306:     const red = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#8f171b' })
307:     for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
308:       const pillar = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.05, 8, 1.05), metal)
309:       pillar.position.set(side * 10.5, 4, 0)
310:       gate.add(pillar)
311:       const cap = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.72, 1.2, 4), red)
312:       cap.position.set(side * 10.5, 8.6, 0); cap.rotation.y = Math.PI / 4
313:       gate.add(cap)
314:     }
315:     const banner = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(21, 3.1, 0.32), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: makeBannerTexture() }))
316:     banner.position.set(0, 7.3, 0)
317:     gate.add(banner)
318:     // checkers on the ground
319:     const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 256; c.height = 64
320:     const cx = c.getContext('2d')
321:     for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) { cx.fillStyle = (i + j) % 2 ? '#e7ddc3' : '#171313'; cx.fillRect(i * 16, j * 16, 16, 16) }
322:     const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c); tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace
323:     const line = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(this.width, 3.2), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: tex }))
324:     line.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2
325:     line.position.y = 0.1
326:     gate.add(line)
327:     this.group.add(gate)
328:     this.gate = gate
329: 
330:     // start lights on gate
331:     this.startLights = []
332:     for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
333:       const l = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.28, 8, 6), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#3a1010' }))
334:       l.position.set(-1.8 + i * 1.8, 5.55, 0.25)
335:       gate.add(l)
336:       this.startLights.push(l)
337:     }
338:   }

340:   buildProps() {
341:     const kind = this.terrain.props
342:     for (const k of kind) this.buildProp(k)
343:     // roadside wreck clusters
344:     if (!kind.includes('wreck')) this.buildProp('wreck')
345:   }

347:   propPositions(count, min = 18, max = 55) {
348:     const out = []
349:     const r = this.rand
350:     for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
351:       const i = Math.floor(r() * N_SAMPLES)
352:       const s = this.samples[i]
353:       const side = r() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1
354:       const lateral = min + r() * (max - min)
355:       const baseY = lateral < 36 ? s.p.y - 0.15 : -0.5
356:       out.push({
357:         x: s.p.x + s.right.x * side * lateral,
358:         y: baseY,
359:         z: s.p.z + s.right.z * side * lateral,
360:         rot: r() * Math.PI * 2,
361:         scale: 0.7 + r() * 1.2,
362:         tangent: s.tan,
363:         side
364:       })
365:     }
366:     return out
367:   }

369:   buildInstanced(geo, material, points, mapFn) {
370:     if (!points.length) return null
371:     const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, material, points.length)
372:     const dummy = new THREE.Object3D()
373:     points.forEach((p, i) => {
374:       mapFn(dummy, p, i)
375:       dummy.updateMatrix()
376:       mesh.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix)
377:     })
378:     this.group.add(mesh)
379:     this.addDisposable(mesh)
380:     return mesh
381:   }

383:   buildProp(kind) {
384:     const t = this.terrain
385:     const baseCol = new THREE.Color(t.ground)
386:     const accent = new THREE.Color(t.accent)
387:     const rockMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: baseCol.clone().multiplyScalar(0.75), flatShading: true })
388:     const darkMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: baseCol.clone().multiplyScalar(0.35), flatShading: true })
389:     const metalMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#2b2927', flatShading: true })
390:     const boneMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#bdb198', flatShading: true })
391:     const acMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: accent })
392:     const pts = this.propPositions(kind === 'mountain' ? 14 : 34, kind === 'mountain' ? 40 : 17, kind === 'mountain' ? 100 : 62)

394:     if (kind === 'rock') {
395:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(1, 0), rockMat, pts, (d, p) => {
396:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 0.6, p.z)
397:         d.rotation.set(p.rot, p.rot * 1.4, p.rot * 0.4)
398:         d.scale.set(p.scale * 2.2, p.scale * 1.5, p.scale * 2)
399:       })
400:     } else if (kind === 'mountain') {

402:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 5, p.z)
403:         d.scale.set(p.scale * 18, p.scale * 18, p.scale * 18)
404:         d.rotation.y = p.rot
405:       })
406:     } else if (kind === 'dune') {
407:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 7, 5), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: baseCol.clone().multiplyScalar(1.15) }), pts, (d, p) => {
408:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y - p.scale * 0.7, p.z)
409:         d.scale.set(p.scale * 9, p.scale * 2.5, p.scale * 7)
410:       })
411:     } else if (kind === 'pine') {
412:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.28, 0.38, 4, 5), darkMat, pts, (d, p) => {
413:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 2, p.z); d.scale.setScalar(p.scale); d.rotation.y = p.rot
414:       })
415:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.ConeGeometry(2.4, 7, 6), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(t.ground).multiplyScalar(0.6), flatShading: true }), pts, (d, p) => {
416:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 5.4, p.z); d.scale.set(p.scale * 1.3, p.scale * 1.6, p.scale * 1.3); d.rotation.y = p.rot
417:       })
418:     } else if (kind === 'tree' || kind === 'palm') {
419:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.35, 0.55, 6, 5), darkMat, pts, (d, p) => {
420:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 3, p.z); d.scale.setScalar(p.scale); d.rotation.z = (p.rot - 3.14) * 0.03
421:       })
422:       const crownCol = new THREE.Color(t.ground).multiplyScalar(0.72).lerp(new THREE.Color(t.accent), 0.18)
423:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(2.4, 0), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: crownCol, flatShading: true }), pts, (d, p) => {
424:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 6.4, p.z)
425:         d.scale.set(p.scale * 1.5, p.scale * (kind === 'palm' ? 0.55 : 1.2), p.scale * 1.5)
426:         d.rotation.y = p.rot
427:       })
428:     } else if (kind === 'cactus') {
429:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.45, 0.55, 4.5, 6), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#4c6138', flatShading: true }), pts, (d, p) => {
430:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 2.2, p.z); d.scale.setScalar(p.scale); d.rotation.y = p.rot
431:       })
432:     } else if (kind === 'fern') {
433:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.ConeGeometry(1.7, 3.2, 5), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#305a2f', flatShading: true }), pts, (d, p) => {
434:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 1.2, p.z); d.scale.setScalar(p.scale); d.rotation.y = p.rot
435:       })
436:     } else if (kind === 'wreck' || kind === 'rubble' || kind === 'cart') {
437:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.BoxGeometry(2.2, 0.9, 4.6), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#4c3a30', flatShading: true }), pts, (d, p) => {
438:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + 0.55, p.z); d.rotation.set((p.rot - 3) * 0.05, p.rot, (p.rot - 3) * 0.03); d.scale.setScalar(p.scale)
439:       })
440:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.8, 0.7, 1.8), darkMat, pts, (d, p) => {
441:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + 1.22, p.z - 0.55 * Math.cos(p.rot)); d.rotation.y = p.rot; d.scale.setScalar(p.scale)
442:       })
443:     } else if (kind === 'tower') {
444:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.BoxGeometry(6, 16, 6), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: baseCol.clone().multiplyScalar(0.5), flatShading: true }), pts, (d, p) => {

624:   nearest(pos, hint = 0, window = 46) {
625:     let best = -1, bestD = Infinity
626:     const start = hint - window, end = hint + window
627:     for (let k = start; k <= end; k++) {
628:       const i = ((k % N_SAMPLES) + N_SAMPLES) % N_SAMPLES
629:       const s = this.samples[i]
630:       const dx = pos.x - s.p.x, dz = pos.z - s.p.z
631:       const d = dx * dx + dz * dz
632:       if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = i }
633:     }
634:     if (bestD > 900) {
635:       for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i += 8) {
636:         const s = this.samples[i]
637:         const dx = pos.x - s.p.x, dz = pos.z - s.p.z
638:         const d = dx * dx + dz * dz
639:         if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = i }
640:       }
641:     }
642:     const s = this.samples[best]
643:     const dx = pos.x - s.p.x, dz = pos.z - s.p.z
644:     const lateral = dx * s.right.x + dz * s.right.z
645:     return { index: best, distance: Math.sqrt(bestD), lateral, sample: s }
646:   }

- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.

### Active

- Verify with a build and screenshot.

1. Apply the off-road racing visual direction while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.

- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.

- HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE is an apocalyptic racing RPG.
- No implementation changes or screenshots have been made yet.

28:     x.fillRect(r() * 256, r() * 512, 1 + r() * 3, 1 + r() * 2)
29:   }
30:   // cracks
31:   x.strokeStyle = 'rgba(4,4,5,0.45)'

34:     let px = r() * 256, py = r() * 512
35:     x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(px, py)
36:     for (let j = 0; j < 5; j++) { px += (r() - 0.5) * 26; py += 10 + r() * 30; x.lineTo(px, py) }
37:     x.stroke()

42:   x.fillRect(241, 0, 3, 512)

45:   for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) x.fillRect(125, i * 86 + 12, 6, 50)
46:   // oil / blood stains
47:   x.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,7,6,0.22)'
48:   for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { x.beginPath(); x.ellipse(r() * 256, r() * 512, 6 + r() * 24, 4 + r() * 13, r() * 3, 0, 7); x.fill() }
49:   const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c)
50:   tex.wrapS = tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping
51:   tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace
52:   tex.anisotropy = 4

86:       void main(){ float h = clamp(normalize(vPos).y * 1.4 + 0.15, 0.0, 1.0); vec3 c = mix(horizonColor, topColor, pow(h, 0.72)); gl_FragColor = vec4(c, 1.0); }`,

96: export class Track {
97:   constructor({ terrain = 'wasteland', weather = 'cloudy', seed = 1, quality = 'medium' } = {}) {
98:     this.terrain = TERRAINS.find(t => t.id === terrain) || TERRAINS[0]
99:     this.weather = WEATHERS.find(w => w.id === weather) || WEATHERS[0]
100:     this.seed = seed
101:     this.quality = quality
102:     this.rand = rng(seed * 7919 + this.terrain.id.length * 131 + this.weather.id.length * 17)
103:     this.width = 15.5
104:     this.group = new THREE.Group()
105:     this.t = 0
106:     this.buildCurve()
107:     this.buildEnvironment()
108:     this.buildRoad()
109:     this.buildGate()
110:     this.buildProps()
111:     this.buildWeather()
112:   }
113: 
114:   buildCurve() {
115:     const r = this.rand
116:     const count = 11
117:     const pts = []
118:     const baseR = 100 + r() * 36
119:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
120:       const a = (i / count) * Math.PI * 2 + (r() - 0.5) * 0.2
121:       const radius = baseR * (0.72 + r() * 0.63)
122:       const elev = (this.terrain.elevation || 2) * (0.4 + 0.6 * Math.sin(a * 3 + r() * 0.7)) * (this.terrain.id === 'mountains' || this.terrain.id === 'volcano' ? 1 : 0.35)
123:       pts.push(new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(a) * radius, elev, Math.sin(a) * radius))
124:     }
125:     pts.push(pts[0].clone())
126:     this.curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts, true, 'catmullrom', 0.5)
127:     this.samples = []
128:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i++) {
129:       const t = i / N_SAMPLES
130:       const p = this.curve.getPointAt(t)
131:       const tan = this.curve.getTangentAt(t)
132:       tan.y = 0
133:       tan.normalize()
134:       const right = new THREE.Vector3(-tan.z, 0, tan.x)
135:       this.samples.push({ p, tan, right })
136:     }
137:     // smooth surface height to avoid nausea
138:     const raw = this.samples.map(s => s.p.y)
139:     for (let iter = 0; iter < 3; iter++) {
140:       for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i++) {
141:         const a = raw[(i - 1 + N_SAMPLES) % N_SAMPLES], b = raw[i], c = raw[(i + 1) % N_SAMPLES]
142:         raw[i] = (a + b * 2 + c) / 4
143:       }
144:     }
145:     this.computeLength()
146:     this.samples.forEach((s, i) => { s.p.y = raw[i] })
147:   }
148: 
149:   computeLength() {
150:     let len = 0
151:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i++) {
152:       const a = this.samples[i].p, b = this.samples[(i + 1) % N_SAMPLES].p
153:       len += a.distanceTo(b)
154:     }
155:     this.length = len
156:   }
157: 
158:   buildEnvironment() {
159:     const t = this.terrain, w = this.weather
160:     this.skyColor = new THREE.Color(t.sky)
161:     this.horizonColor = new THREE.Color(t.horizon).lerp(new THREE.Color(w.tint), 0.25)
162:     this.fogColor = new THREE.Color(t.fog).lerp(new THREE.Color(w.tint), 0.35)
163:     this.skyMat = makeSkyMaterial('#' + this.skyColor.getHexString(), '#' + this.horizonColor.getHexString())
164:     this.sky = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(450, 24, 12), this.skyMat)
165:     this.group.add(this.sky)
166: 
167:     const sun = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(55, 55), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: makeSunTexture(), transparent: true, depthWrite: false, fog: false }))
168:     sun.position.set(-140, 90, -210)
169:     sun.lookAt(0, 0, 0)
170:     this.group.add(sun)
171:     this.sun = sun
172: 
173:     const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xa4b5c8, new THREE.Color(t.ground).multiplyScalar(0.38), 0.9)
174:     this.group.add(hemi)
175:     this.hemi = hemi
176:     const dir = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffb27a, 1.35)
177:     dir.position.set(-60, 90, -40)
178:     this.group.add(dir)
179:     this.dir = dir
180:     const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x7890b8, 0.5)
181:     fill.position.set(40, 30, 60)
182:     this.group.add(fill)
183: 
184:     // ground
185:     const ground = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(600, 600, 1, 1), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(t.ground).multiplyScalar(0.7) }))
186:     ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2
187:     ground.position.y = -0.6
188:     this.group.add(ground)
189:     this.ground = ground
190: 
191:     // distant mountain ring
192:     const r = this.rand
193:     const ringMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(t.ground).lerp(this.fogColor, 0.55), flatShading: true })
194:     for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
195:       const a = (i / 26) * Math.PI * 2 + r() * 0.15
196:       const dist = 220 + r() * 80
197:       const h = 30 + r() * 85
198:       const cone = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(24 + r() * 40, h, 5 + Math.floor(r() * 2)), ringMat)
199:       cone.position.set(Math.cos(a) * dist, h * 0.34 - 4, Math.sin(a) * dist)
200:       cone.rotation.y = r() * 3
201:       this.group.add(cone)
202:       this.addDisposable(cone)
203:     }
204:     this.addDisposable(ground)
205:   }
206: 
207:   buildRoad() {
208:     const { samples, width } = this
209:     const roadW = width
210:     const landW = 66
211:     const positions = [], uvs = [], indices = []
212:     const landPos = [], landIdx = []
213:     for (let i = 0; i <= N_SAMPLES; i++) {
214:       const s = samples[i % N_SAMPLES]
215:       const y = s.p.y
216:       const lx = s.p.x - s.right.x * roadW / 2, lz = s.p.z - s.right.z * roadW / 2
217:       const rx = s.p.x + s.right.x * roadW / 2, rz = s.p.z + s.right.z * roadW / 2
218:       positions.push(lx, y + 0.06, lz, rx, y + 0.06, rz)
219:       const v = i * (this.length / N_SAMPLES) / 7
220:       uvs.push(0, v, 1, v)
221:       // land: outer low, inner high
222:       landPos.push(
223:         s.p.x - s.right.x * landW, y - 0.6, s.p.z - s.right.z * landW,
224:         s.p.x - s.right.x * (roadW / 2 + 0.7), y - 0.02, s.p.z - s.right.z * (roadW / 2 + 0.7),
225:         s.p.x + s.right.x * (roadW / 2 + 0.7), y - 0.02, s.p.z + s.right.z * (roadW / 2 + 0.7),
226:         s.p.x + s.right.x * landW, y - 0.6, s.p.z + s.right.z * landW
227:       )
228:     }
229:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i++) {
230:       const a = i * 2, b = a + 1, c = a + 2, d = a + 3
231:       indices.push(a, b, c, b, d, c)
232:       const l = i * 4
233:       // left slope
234:       landIdx.push(l, l + 1, l + 4, l + 1, l + 5, l + 4)
235:       // center
236:       landIdx.push(l + 1, l + 2, l + 5, l + 2, l + 6, l + 5)
237:       // right slope
238:       landIdx.push(l + 2, l + 3, l + 6, l + 3, l + 7, l + 6)
239:     }
240:     const roadGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
241:     roadGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3))
242:     roadGeo.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2))
243:     roadGeo.setIndex(indices)
244:     roadGeo.computeVertexNormals()
245:     const roadMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: makeRoadTexture(this.terrain), color: '#ffffff' })
246:     const road = new THREE.Mesh(roadGeo, roadMat)
247:     this.group.add(road)
248:     this.road = road
249:     this.addDisposable(road)
250: 
251:     const landGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
252:     landGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(landPos, 3))
253:     landGeo.setIndex(landIdx)
254:     landGeo.computeVertexNormals()
255:     const landMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(this.terrain.ground), flatShading: true })
256:     const land = new THREE.Mesh(landGeo, landMat)
257:     this.group.add(land)
258:     this.land = land
259:     this.addDisposable(land)
260: 
261:     // edge markers / barrier posts (instanced)
262:     const postGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.18, 0.9, 0.18)
263:     const postMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(this.terrain.accent).multiplyScalar(0.55) })
264:     const posts = new THREE.InstancedMesh(postGeo, postMat, Math.floor(N_SAMPLES / 10) * 2)
265:     const dummy = new THREE.Object3D()
266:     let pi = 0
267:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i += 10) {
268:       const s = samples[i]
269:       for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
270:         dummy.position.set(s.p.x + s.right.x * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.2), s.p.y + 0.45, s.p.z + s.right.z * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.2))
271:         dummy.rotation.y = Math.atan2(s.tan.x, s.tan.z)
272:         dummy.updateMatrix()
273:         posts.setMatrixAt(pi++, dummy.matrix)
274:       }
275:     }
276:     posts.count = pi
277:     this.group.add(posts)
278:     this.addDisposable(posts)
279: 
280:     // glowing reflectors
281:     const refGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.16, 6, 5)
282:     const refMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: this.terrain.accent })
283:     const refs = new THREE.InstancedMesh(refGeo, refMat, 80)
284:     let ri = 0
285:     for (let i = 0; i < N_SAMPLES; i += 20) {
286:       const s = samples[i]
287:       for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
288:         dummy.position.set(s.p.x + s.right.x * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.25), s.p.y + 1.02, s.p.z + s.right.z * side * (roadW / 2 + 1.25))
289:         dummy.rotation.set(0, 0, 0)
290:         dummy.updateMatrix()
291:         refs.setMatrixAt(ri++, dummy.matrix)
292:       }
293:     }
294:     refs.count = ri
295:     this.group.add(refs)
296:     this.addDisposable(refs)
297:   }
298: 
299:   buildGate() {
300:     const s = this.samples[0]
301:     const yaw = Math.atan2(s.tan.x, s.tan.z)
302:     const gate = new THREE.Group()
303:     gate.position.copy(s.p)
304:     gate.rotation.y = yaw
305:     const metal = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#24211f' })
306:     const red = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#8f171b' })
307:     for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
308:       const pillar = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.05, 8, 1.05), metal)
309:       pillar.position.set(side * 10.5, 4, 0)
310:       gate.add(pillar)
311:       const cap = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.72, 1.2, 4), red)
312:       cap.position.set(side * 10.5, 8.6, 0); cap.rotation.y = Math.PI / 4
313:       gate.add(cap)
314:     }
315:     const banner = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(21, 3.1, 0.32), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: makeBannerTexture() }))
316:     banner.position.set(0, 7.3, 0)
317:     gate.add(banner)
318:     // checkers on the ground
319:     const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 256; c.height = 64
320:     const cx = c.getContext('2d')
321:     for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) { cx.fillStyle = (i + j) % 2 ? '#e7ddc3' : '#171313'; cx.fillRect(i * 16, j * 16, 16, 16) }
322:     const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c); tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace
323:     const line = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(this.width, 3.2), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: tex }))
324:     line.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2
325:     line.position.y = 0.1
326:     gate.add(line)
327:     this.group.add(gate)
328:     this.gate = gate
329: 
330:     // start lights on gate
331:     this.startLights = []
332:     for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
333:       const l = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.28, 8, 6), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#3a1010' }))
334:       l.position.set(-1.8 + i * 1.8, 5.55, 0.25)
335:       gate.add(l)
336:       this.startLights.push(l)
337:     }
338:   }

340:   buildProps() {
341:     const kind = this.terrain.props
342:     for (const k of kind) this.buildProp(k)
343:     // roadside wreck clusters
344:     if (!kind.includes('wreck')) this.buildProp('wreck')
345:   }
346: 
347:   propPositions(count, min = 18, max = 55) {
348:     const out = []
349:     const r = this.rand
350:     for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
351:       const i = Math.floor(r() * N_SAMPLES)
352:       const s = this.samples[i]
353:       const side = r() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1
354:       const lateral = min + r() * (max - min)
355:       const baseY = lateral < 36 ? s.p.y - 0.15 : -0.5
356:       out.push({
357:         x: s.p.x + s.right.x * side * lateral,
358:         y: baseY,
359:         z: s.p.z + s.right.z * side * lateral,
360:         rot: r() * Math.PI * 2,
361:         scale: 0.7 + r() * 1.2,
362:         tangent: s.tan,
363:         side
364:       })
365:     }
366:     return out
367:   }
368: 
369:   buildInstanced(geo, material, points, mapFn) {
370:     if (!points.length) return null
371:     const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, material, points.length)
372:     const dummy = new THREE.Object3D()
373:     points.forEach((p, i) => {
374:       mapFn(dummy, p, i)
375:       dummy.updateMatrix()
376:       mesh.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix)
377:     })
378:     this.group.add(mesh)
379:     this.addDisposable(mesh)
380:     return mesh
381:   }
382: 
383:   buildProp(kind) {
384:     const t = this.terrain
385:     const baseCol = new THREE.Color(t.ground)
386:     const accent = new THREE.Color(t.accent)
387:     const rockMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: baseCol.clone().multiplyScalar(0.75), flatShading: true })
388:     const darkMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: baseCol.clone().multiplyScalar(0.35), flatShading: true })
389:     const metalMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#2b2927', flatShading: true })
390:     const boneMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#bdb198', flatShading: true })
391:     const acMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: accent })
392:     const pts = this.propPositions(kind === 'mountain' ? 14 : 34, kind === 'mountain' ? 40 : 17, kind === 'mountain' ? 100 : 62)
393: 
394:     if (kind === 'rock') {
395:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(1, 0), rockMat, pts, (d, p) => {
396:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 0.6, p.z)
397:         d.rotation.set(p.rot, p.rot * 1.4, p.rot * 0.4)
398:         d.scale.set(p.scale * 2.2, p.scale * 1.5, p.scale * 2)
399:       })
400:     } else if (kind === 'mountain') {
401:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.ConeGeometry(1, 1, 5), rockMat, pts, (d, p) => {
402:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 5, p.z)
403:         d.scale.set(p.scale * 18, p.scale * 18, p.scale * 18)
404:         d.rotation.y = p.rot
405:       })
406:     } else if (kind === 'dune') {
407:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 7, 5), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: baseCol.clone().multiplyScalar(1.15) }), pts, (d, p) => {
408:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y - p.scale * 0.7, p.z)
409:         d.scale.set(p.scale * 9, p.scale * 2.5, p.scale * 7)
410:       })
411:     } else if (kind === 'pine') {
412:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.28, 0.38, 4, 5), darkMat, pts, (d, p) => {
413:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 2, p.z); d.scale.setScalar(p.scale); d.rotation.y = p.rot
414:       })
415:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.ConeGeometry(2.4, 7, 6), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(t.ground).multiplyScalar(0.6), flatShading: true }), pts, (d, p) => {
416:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 5.4, p.z); d.scale.set(p.scale * 1.3, p.scale * 1.6, p.scale * 1.3); d.rotation.y = p.rot
417:       })
418:     } else if (kind === 'tree' || kind === 'palm') {
419:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.35, 0.55, 6, 5), darkMat, pts, (d, p) => {
420:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 3, p.z); d.scale.setScalar(p.scale); d.rotation.z = (p.rot - 3.14) * 0.03
421:       })
422:       const crownCol = new THREE.Color(t.ground).multiplyScalar(0.72).lerp(new THREE.Color(t.accent), 0.18)
423:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(2.4, 0), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: crownCol, flatShading: true }), pts, (d, p) => {
424:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 6.4, p.z)
425:         d.scale.set(p.scale * 1.5, p.scale * (kind === 'palm' ? 0.55 : 1.2), p.scale * 1.5)
426:         d.rotation.y = p.rot
427:       })
428:     } else if (kind === 'cactus') {
429:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.45, 0.55, 4.5, 6), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#4c6138', flatShading: true }), pts, (d, p) => {
430:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 2.2, p.z); d.scale.setScalar(p.scale); d.rotation.y = p.rot
431:       })
432:     } else if (kind === 'fern') {
433:       this.buildInstanced(new THREE.ConeGeometry(1.7, 3.2, 5), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#305a2f', flatShading: true }), pts, (d, p) => {
434:         d.position.set(p.x, p.y + p.scale * 1.2, p.z); d.scale.setScalar(p.scale); d.rotation.y = p.rot

## Objective
- Adapt HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE’s graphics toward Slipface’s rugged off-road racing aesthetic while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.
- Save check screenshots as small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Infer Slipface’s style as rugged off-road racing with deformable terrain; no reference screenshots or assets were found in the repository.
- Shift track visuals from paved roads and ruined-city scenery toward packed dirt, tire ruts, and desert rally terrain.

## Work State
### Completed
- Replaced asphalt-like track texture with packed-dirt grain, tire grooves, and washboard scuffs in `src/track.js`.
- Updated `src/menu-bg.js` menu backdrop road to use textured dirt with tire ruts.

- Finish the menu backdrop shift from ruined skyline to mesas, ridges, and sparse scrub.

- None.

1. Replace the ruined skyline section in `src/menu-bg.js` (the prior exact-text edit failed because its match did not match the file).

## Relevant Files
- `src/menu-bg.js`: Procedural menu backdrop; dirt road changes are in place, skyline replacement remains.
- `src/track.js`: Track surface texture now has dirt and tire-rut styling.
- `package.json`: Build scripts.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no build or screenshot verification has been performed.

## Objective
- Adapt HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE’s graphics toward Slipface’s rugged off-road racing aesthetic while retaining HELLRIDE’s identity.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.
- Save check screenshots as small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Infer Slipface’s style as rugged off-road racing with deformable terrain; no reference screenshots or assets were found in the repository.
- Shift track visuals from paved roads and ruined-city scenery toward packed dirt, tire ruts, and desert rally terrain.

## Work State
### Completed
- Updated `src/track.js` with packed-dirt texture, tire grooves, and washboard scuffs.
- Updated `src/menu-bg.js` with textured dirt, layered desert ridges, and sparse scrub replacing the ruined skyline.

- (none)

- (none)

1. (none)

- `src/menu-bg.js`: Procedural menu backdrop and rally scenery.
- `src/track.js`: Track surface textures.
- `screenshots/menu-dirt-check.jpg`: Latest inspected visual check.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; only `src/menu-bg.js` and `src/track.js` are modified.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Improve HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE’s graphics with multiple-angle visuals while retaining its rugged off-road racing aesthetic.
- Add a story and build script centered on Mandy the evil Queen of Racing and her drivers/generals.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.
- Save visual-check screenshots as small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- The campaign story is being added to the existing boss/career structure.
- Interpret “multiple angle graphics” as improving visual presentation with multiple viewing angles; exact implementation is still pending.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/track.js` has packed-dirt texture, tire grooves, and washboard scuffs.
- `src/menu-bg.js` has textured dirt, desert ridges, and sparse scrub in place of ruined-city scenery.
- Previous visual check passed: `screenshots/menu-dirt-check.jpg` at 1280×800 was inspected; build and `git diff --check` passed.
- Added `CAMPAIGN_STORY` to `src/data.js` and expanded story/description text for Ichi, Chloe, Timone, Domino, and Sussie.

### Active
- Improve the graphics with multiple-angle visuals.
- Complete and integrate story/build-script content for the requested characters.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the remaining boss entries and current visual presentation, then implement multi-angle graphics in a way that fits existing Three.js vehicle previews.
2. Finish requested character/story updates and integrate campaign story text into the career UI.
3. Build, run `git diff --check`, and capture/inspect a compliant screenshot if the UI changes warrant it.

## Relevant Files
- `src/garage.js`: Three.js garage vehicle preview; currently animates the car’s rotation.
- `src/car.js`: Vehicle model construction.
- `src/data.js`: Boss roster and newly added `CAMPAIGN_STORY`.
- `src/app.js`: Career screen and boss detail modal.
- `src/styles.css`: Career and boss UI styling.
- `src/track.js`: Procedural track surfaces.
- `src/menu-bg.js`: Procedural menu backdrop.
- `screenshots/menu-dirt-check.jpg`: Latest previously inspected visual check.

## Important Context
- The boss roster has 11 characters: eight underbosses and three main bosses, with career progress displayed as `/11`.
- The new campaign-story data has not yet been rendered by the UI.
- Changes are uncommitted; earlier work changed `src/menu-bg.js` and `src/track.js`, and newer work changed `src/data.js`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Improve HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE’s graphics with multiple-angle visuals while retaining its rugged off-road racing aesthetic.
- Add a story and build script centered on Mandy the evil Queen of Racing and her drivers/generals.

## Requirements
- “Improve graphics with multiple angle graphics”
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.
- Save visual-check screenshots as small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Add the campaign story to the existing boss/career structure.
- Interpret “multiple angle graphics” as improving visual presentation through multiple viewing angles, building on the existing Three.js vehicle previews.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/track.js` has packed-dirt texture, tire grooves, and washboard scuffs.
- `src/menu-bg.js` has textured dirt, desert ridges, and sparse scrub in place of ruined-city scenery.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Improve HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE’s graphics with multiple-angle vehicle visuals while retaining its rugged off-road racing aesthetic.
- Add a story and build script centered on Mandy-Lee, the evil Queen of Racing, and her drivers/generals.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.
- Save visual-check screenshots as small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Add the campaign story to the existing boss/career structure.
- Interpret “multiple angle graphics” as adding interactive viewing angles to the existing Three.js garage vehicle preview.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/track.js` has packed-dirt texture, tire grooves, and washboard scuffs.
- `src/menu-bg.js` has textured dirt, desert ridges, and sparse scrub in place of ruined-city scenery.
- `src/data.js` has `CAMPAIGN_STORY` and story entries for Ichi, Chloe, Timone, Domino, and Sussie.

### Active
- Implement garage preview camera movement and angle controls.
- Integrate campaign story into the career UI and fill missing boss story entries.
- Run build and `git diff --check`; take and inspect a compliant screenshot if UI changes warrant it.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Finish camera controls and movement in `src/garage.js`; camera state fields and `cameraLookAt` exist, but control behavior is not implemented.
2. Add angle buttons/interactions to `src/app.js` and styling to `src/styles.css`.
3. Render `CAMPAIGN_STORY` in the career UI and add story entries for bosses missing them.
4. Build, run `git diff --check`, and perform a compliant visual check if appropriate.

## Relevant Files
- `src/garage.js`: Three.js garage vehicle preview; camera target/current, drag fields, look-at vector, and a call to `bindCameraControls()` were added, but the method and behavior are unfinished.
- `src/app.js`: Career screen, boss detail modal, and garage preview UI.
- `src/data.js`: Boss roster and `CAMPAIGN_STORY`; not every boss currently has a `story`.
- `src/styles.css`: Career and garage UI styles.
- `src/car.js`: Vehicle model construction.

## Important Context
- Boss roster has 11 characters: eight underbosses and three main bosses; career progress displays `/11`.
- Changes are uncommitted; earlier work changed `src/menu-bg.js`, `src/track.js`, and `src/data.js`; camera state edits are in `src/garage.js`.

resize() {
    const parent = this.canvas.parentElement
    if (!parent) return
    const w = parent.clientWidth || 600
    const h = parent.clientHeight || 360
    this.renderer.setSize(w, h, false)
    this.camera.aspect = w / h
    this.camera.fov = w / h < 1 ? 46 : 34
    this.camera.updateProjectionMatrix()
  }

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Improve HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE’s graphics with multiple-angle vehicle visuals while retaining its rugged off-road aesthetic.
- Add a story and build script centered on Mandy-Lee, the evil Queen of Racing, and her drivers/generals.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.
- Save visual-check screenshots as small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Add the campaign story to the existing boss/career structure.
- Interpret “multiple angle graphics” as interactive viewing angles in the existing Three.js garage vehicle preview.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/track.js` has packed-dirt texture, tire grooves, and washboard scuffs.
- `src/menu-bg.js` has textured dirt, desert ridges, and sparse scrub in place of ruined-city scenery.
- `src/data.js` has `CAMPAIGN_STORY` and story entries for Ichi, Chloe, Timone, Domino, and Sussie.
- `src/garage.js` has drag-to-orbit, wheel zoom, and preset camera-angle behavior implemented; controls include pointer capture, elevation/radius limits, and front/side/rear/reset presets.

### Active
- Add angle buttons to the garage UI in `src/app.js` and matching styles in `src/styles.css`; the preview currently looks for `[data-camera-angle]` controls in its canvas parent.
- Render `CAMPAIGN_STORY` in the career UI and add story entries for bosses missing them.
- Build, run `git diff --check`, and perform a compliant visual check if appropriate.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add garage angle preset buttons (`front`, `side`, `rear`, `reset`) to `src/app.js`, ensuring they are inside the canvas parent searched by `bindCameraControls()`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Improve HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE’s graphics with multiple-angle vehicle visuals while retaining its rugged off-road aesthetic.
- Add a story centered on Mandy-Lee, the evil Queen of Racing, and her drivers/generals.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.
- Save visual-check screenshots as small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Add the campaign story to the existing boss/career structure.
- Interpret “multiple angle graphics” as interactive viewing angles in the existing Three.js garage vehicle preview.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/track.js` has packed-dirt texture, tire grooves, and washboard scuffs.
- `src/menu-bg.js` has textured dirt, desert ridges, and sparse scrub in place of ruined-city scenery.
- `src/data.js` has `CAMPAIGN_STORY` and story entries for Ichi, Chloe, Timone, Domino, and Sussie.
- `src/app.js` imports `CAMPAIGN_STORY`, renders it in the career screen, and shows boss story text in the boss modal, falling back to `desc` when a story is absent.
- `src/app.js` has front/side/rear/reset angle buttons inside the garage stage and an updated drag/zoom hint.
- `src/garage.js` has pointer-drag, wheel-zoom, and angle-preset event handlers.

### Active
- Add story entries for bosses missing them: Jill, Bubbles, Oscar, Mandy-Lee, Zanrich, and Drikus.
- Style the campaign story, boss story, and garage angle controls in `src/styles.css`.
- Complete and verify camera movement: `GaragePreview.loop()` currently does not apply the camera target/radius to the camera, so the new controls will not yet change the rendered view.
- Build, run `git diff --check`, and perform a compliant visual check if practical.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add missing boss story entries in `src/data.js`.
2. Add styling in `src/styles.css` for campaign story, boss-modal story, and garage angle buttons.
3. Update `GaragePreview.loop()` in `src/garage.js` to smoothly apply the camera target and zoom radius.
4. Run `npm run build` and `git diff --check`; visually verify if practical, following the screenshot constraints.

## Relevant Files
- `src/app.js`: career story rendering, boss modal, and garage angle-button markup.
- `src/data.js`: `CAMPAIGN_STORY` and boss roster/story entries.
- `src/garage.js`: garage preview camera controls and render loop.
- `src/styles.css`: career, boss modal, and garage styles.
- `package.json`: build command is `npm run build`.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; earlier work changed `src/menu-bg.js`, `src/track.js`, `src/data.js`, and `src/garage.js`.
- `GaragePreview.bindCameraControls()` queries `[data-camera-angle]` buttons from the canvas parent during construction; the buttons are now inside that parent.

   title: 'The Crownroad War',
   intro: 'When the old world burned, the racing circuits became borders and the finish line became law. Mandy-Lee crowned herself Queen of Racing, then sent her generals to seize every road worth owning.    chapters: [
     {
-      title: 'I · The Generals’ Road',
-      text: 'General Ichi, the jackal-faced commander, guards the Black Nile pass. General Chloe and her hellhound crew hold the frozen route. Break their command, take their machines, and the road to the throne opens.'
+      title: 'I · Ashes at the Starting Line',
+      text: 'The first invitation is a wrecked car left across your path, its hood stamped with Mandy-Lee’s crown. The Queen has outlawed independent races; every road now pays her toll. You have a patched engine, a half-empty tank, and no crew. Win the first scraps of territory and the scattered settlements begin to whisper your name.'
     },
     {
-      title: 'II · The Three Thrones',
-      text: 'Mandy-Lee is the evil Queen of Racing: every track is her court and every rival is tribute. Her champion Zanrich drives like an animal freed from its cage, while Drikus, King of Insanity, turns the final race into a game with rules only he understands. Defeat all three, and the crown—and the future of the wasteland—are yours to decide.'
+      title: 'II · The Generals’ Road',
+      text: 'Ichi weighs your nerve in the Black Nile mines. Chloe sends her hellhound pack across the frozen border. +    },
+    {
+      title: 'III · No Safe Shoulder',
+      text: 'The closer you get to the capital, the less the races resemble races. Domino turns the suburbs into a maze of false shortcuts. Bubbles makes the flooded coast a laughing demolition pit. Oscar waits in the blackout streets, where an engine note is the only warning. At the edge of the wasteland, Sussie burns through the Queen’s last reserve of boost fuel in a three-lap chase. Break the final underboss and the whole frontier rises behind you—but Mandy-Lee has already heard the revolt coming.'
+    },
+    {
+      title: 'IV · The Queen’s Redline',
+      text: 'Mandy-Lee meets you beneath the dead neon, crowned in black steel and surrounded by the machines she took from every defeated rival. She offers one bargain: kneel, keep your car, and live under her flag. Refuse, and the capital becomes a single brutal circuit. The Queen drives to erase the rebellion in one night. Beat her, and the crown is yours to refuse—or claim.'
+    },
+    {
+      title: 'V · The Beast and the Last Laugh',

The route changes, the rules collapse, and every rival you spared—or inspired—rides the storm with you.      }

const cameraEase = 1 - Math.exp(-8 * dt)
    const angleDelta = THREE.MathUtils.euclideanModulo(this.cameraTarget.azimuth - this.cameraCurrent.azimuth + Math.PI, Math.PI * 2) - Math.PI
    this.cameraCurrent.azimuth += angleDelta * cameraEase
    this.cameraCurrent.elevation += (this.cameraTarget.elevation - this.cameraCurrent.elevation) * cameraEase
    this.cameraCurrentRadius += (this.cameraRadius - this.cameraCurrentRadius) * cameraEase
    const horizontalRadius = Math.cos(this.cameraCurrent.elevation) * this.cameraCurrentRadius
    this.camera.position.set(
      Math.sin(this.cameraCurrent.azimuth) * horizontalRadius,
      this.cameraLookAt.y + Math.sin(this.cameraCurrent.elevation) * this.cameraCurrentRadius,
      Math.cos(this.cameraCurrent.azimuth) * horizontalRadius
    )
    this.camera.lookAt(this.cameraLookAt)

## Objective
- Improve HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE’s graphics with interactive vehicle viewing angles and create a long, ascending campaign story with entries for all drivers and characters.

## Requirements
- Add story entries for all drivers and characters.
- Build the project.

## Decisions
- Campaign story is integrated into the existing career and boss structure.
- “Multiple angle graphics” means interactive viewing angles in the Three.js garage preview.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a five-chapter escalating campaign arc in `src/data.js`.
- Added story entries for every boss in the roster.
- Added front/side/rear/reset controls and drag/zoom handlers for the garage preview.
- Updated the render loop to apply camera orbit, elevation, and zoom smoothly.

### Active
- Identify all other driver/character rosters and add story entries where needed.
- Style the campaign story, boss story, and garage angle controls in `src/styles.css`.
- Run the requested build and `git diff --check`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect driver and character definitions beyond the boss roster, then add story entries for those without them.
2. Style campaign and boss story sections and garage angle controls.
3. Run `npm run build` and `git diff --check`; report results.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: campaign chapters, boss roster and story entries, and game data.
- `src/app.js`: campaign/boss story rendering and garage angle-control markup.
- `src/garage.js`: garage preview camera controls and render loop.
- `src/styles.css`: styles still needed for the story sections and angle controls.
- `src/race.js`: race driver setup and AI driver definitions.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The latest actions only inspected roster references and `package.json`; the build has not been run.

## Objective
- Improve HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE’s graphics with interactive vehicle viewing angles and create a long, ascending campaign story with entries for all drivers and characters.
- Build the project.

## Requirements
- Add story entries for all drivers and characters.
- Build the project.

## Decisions
- Integrate the campaign story into the existing career and boss structure.
- Interpret “multiple angle graphics” as interactive viewing angles in the Three.js garage preview.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a five-chapter escalating campaign arc in `src/data.js`.
- Added story entries for all 11 bosses in the roster.
- Added front/side/rear/reset controls, drag/zoom handlers, and smoothed camera orbit, elevation, and zoom for the garage preview.

### Active
- Identify any non-boss driver/character rosters that need story entries; `src/race.js` uses `RIVALS` and named pursuit characters.
- Style the campaign story, boss story, and garage angle controls in `src/styles.css`.
- Run `npm run build` and `git diff --check`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the `RIVALS` definitions and any other non-boss character rosters; add story entries where needed.
2. Add styling for campaign and boss story sections and garage angle controls.
3. Run `npm run build` and `git diff --check`; report results.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Campaign chapters, boss roster and stories, and game data.
- `src/app.js`: Campaign/boss story rendering and garage angle-control markup.
- `src/garage.js`: Garage preview camera controls and render loop.
- `src/styles.css`: Styles for story sections and angle controls still needed.
- `src/race.js`: Race driver setup and AI driver definitions.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The build has not been run.

## Objective
- Improve HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE’s graphics with interactive vehicle viewing angles and create a long, ascending campaign story with entries for all drivers and characters.
- Build the project.

## Requirements
- Add story entries for all drivers and characters.
- Build the project.

## Decisions
- Integrate the campaign story into the existing career and boss structure.
- Interpret “multiple angle graphics” as interactive viewing angles in the Three.js garage preview.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a five-chapter escalating campaign arc in `src/data.js`.
- Added story entries for all 11 bosses in the roster.
- Added front/side/rear/reset controls, drag/zoom handlers, and smoothed camera orbit, elevation, and zoom for the garage preview.

### Active
- Identify any non-boss driver/character rosters that need story entries; `src/race.js` uses `RIVALS` and named pursuit characters.
- Style the campaign story, boss story, and garage angle controls in `src/styles.css`.
- Run `npm run build` and `git diff --check`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `RIVALS` and other non-boss character rosters; add story entries where needed.
2. Add styling for campaign and boss story sections and garage angle controls.
3. Run `npm run build` and `git diff --check`; report results.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Campaign chapters, boss roster and stories, and game data.
- `src/app.js`: Campaign/boss story rendering and garage angle-control markup.
- `src/garage.js`: Garage preview camera controls and render loop.
- `src/styles.css`: Styles for story sections and angle controls still needed.
- `src/race.js`: Race driver setup and AI driver definitions.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The build has not been run.

## Objective
- Improve HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE’s graphics with interactive vehicle viewing angles and create a long, ascending campaign story with entries for all drivers and characters.
- Build the project.

## Requirements
- Add story entries for all drivers and characters.
- Build the project.

## Decisions
- Integrate the campaign story into the existing career and boss structure.
- Interpret “multiple angle graphics” as interactive viewing angles in the Three.js garage preview.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a five-chapter escalating campaign arc in `src/data.js`.
- Added story entries for all 11 bosses in the roster.
- Added front/side/rear/reset controls, drag/zoom handlers, and smoothed camera orbit, elevation, and zoom for the garage preview.

### Active
- Identify non-boss driver and character rosters needing story entries, including `RIVALS` and named pursuit characters.
- Style campaign story, boss story, and garage angle controls in `src/styles.css`.
- Run `npm run build` and `git diff --check`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move

- Improve HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE with interactive vehicle viewing angles and a long, ascending campaign story covering its drivers and characters.
- Build the project and check the changes.

## Requirements
- Add story entries for all drivers and characters.
- Build the project.

## Decisions
- Integrate the campaign story into the existing career and boss structure.
- Interpret “multiple angle graphics” as interactive viewing angles in the Three.js garage preview.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a five-chapter escalating campaign arc and story entries for all 11 bosses in `src/data.js`.
- Added front, side, rear, and reset controls plus drag/zoom camera interaction for the garage preview.
- Added campaign and boss story rendering and garage angle-control markup.

### Active
- Add story entries for non-boss drivers and characters, including the eight `RIVALS` and named pursuit characters.
- Style the campaign story, boss story, and garage angle controls in `src/styles.css`.
- Run `npm run build` and `git diff --check`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add stories for the rival roster and named pursuit drivers in `src/race.js`.
2. Style campaign and boss story sections and garage angle controls in `src/styles.css`.
3. Run `npm run build` and `git diff --check`, then report results.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Campaign chapters and stories for all bosses.
- `src/race.js`: `RIVALS` and named pursuit characters that still need stories.
- `src/app.js`: Campaign/boss story and garage angle-control markup.
- `src/garage.js`: Garage preview camera controls and render loop.
- `src/styles.css`: Styles for the new story sections and angle controls are still needed.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted. `git status` showed modified `src/app.js`, `src/data.js`, `src/garage.js`, `src/menu-bg.js`, and `src/track.js`, plus changes to `dist/`; preserve existing work.
- The build has not been run.

## Objective
- Improve HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE with interactive vehicle viewing angles and a long, ascending campaign story covering its drivers and characters.
- Build the project and check the changes.

## Requirements
- Add story entries for all drivers and characters, including non-boss rosters.
- Style the campaign and boss story sections and garage angle controls.
- Run `npm run build` and `git diff --check`.

## Decisions
- Integrate the campaign story into the existing career and boss structure.
- Interpret “multiple angle graphics” as interactive viewing angles in the Three.js garage preview.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a five-chapter escalating campaign arc and story entries for all 11 bosses in `src/data.js`.
- Added front, side, rear, and reset controls plus drag/zoom camera interaction for the garage preview.
- Added campaign and boss story rendering and garage angle-control markup.

### Active
- Add story entries for the eight `RIVALS` and named pursuit drivers in `src/race.js`.
- Add styles for campaign and boss story sections and garage angle controls in `src/styles.css`.
- Run `npm run build` and `git diff --check`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add story entries for the rival roster and named pursuit drivers.
2. Style the campaign story, boss story, and garage angle controls.
3. Run `npm run build` and `git diff --check`, then report results.

## Relevant Files
- `src/race.js`: `RIVALS` and named pursuit drivers to receive story entries.
- `src/data.js`: Campaign chapters and stories for all bosses.
- `src/app.js`: Campaign/boss story and garage angle-control markup.
- `src/garage.js`: Garage preview camera controls and render loop.
- `src/styles.css`: Styles for the new story sections and angle controls are still needed.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted. Earlier `git status` showed modified `src/app.js`, `src/data.js`, `src/garage.js`, `src/menu-bg.js`, and `src/track.js`, plus changes to `dist/`; preserve existing work.
- The latest inspection confirmed campaign and boss story markup and garage angle-control markup exist; corresponding styles were not found.
- The build and diff check have not been run.

  { name: 'Halo', origin: 'demigod', vehicle: 'valkyrie', color: '#b8b2a2', accent: '#ffcf6a', story: 'A fallen sky-knight who abandoned the throne roads after seeing what the Queen did to the ground below. Halo still fights by a code, though the wasteland keeps trying to break it.' },

## Objective
- Improve HELLRIDE: APOCALYPSE with interactive garage vehicle viewing angles and a long, escalating campaign story covering drivers and characters.
- Build the project and check the changes.

## Requirements
- Add story entries for all drivers and characters, including non-boss rosters.
- Style the campaign and boss story sections and garage angle controls.
- Run `npm run build` and `git diff --check`.

## Decisions
- Integrate the campaign story into the existing career and boss structure.
- Interpret “multiple angle graphics” as interactive viewing angles in the Three.js garage preview.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a five-chapter campaign arc and story entries for all 11 bosses in `src/data.js`.
- Added front, side, rear, and reset controls plus drag/zoom camera interaction for the garage preview.
- Added campaign and boss story rendering and garage angle-control markup.
- Added story entries for the eight rivals and named gang/police pursuit drivers in `src/race.js`.
- Added campaign-story and boss-story styles in `src/styles.css`.

### Active
- Style the garage angle controls.
- Run `npm run build` and `git diff --check`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add responsive styles for `.garage-angle-controls` and its buttons in `src/styles.css`.
2. Run `npm run build` and `git diff --check`; resolve any issues while preserving existing work.
3. Report the results.

## Relevant Files
- `src/race.js`: Rival and pursuit-driver story entries.
- `src/data.js`: Campaign chapters and boss stories.
- `src/app.js`: Campaign/boss story and garage angle-control markup.
- `src/garage.js`: Garage preview camera controls and render loop.
- `src/styles.css`: Story styling is added; garage angle-control styling remains.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted. Existing status included modified `src/app.js`, `src/data.js`, `src/garage.js`, `src/menu-bg.js`, and `src/track.js`; `src/race.js` and `src/styles.css` have since also been edited.
- `dist/` had existing changes: modified `dist/index.html`, deleted `dist/assets/index-BxIPhxIF.js`, and untracked `dist/assets/index-2DXABfxN.js`. Preserve them.
